acanthocobitis-botia.name: Zipper loach
notes: Item 1: "Dulu ikan ini lama dianggap" is awkward; use "Ikan ini lama dianggap" or "Dulu dianggap".
Item 5: "beech, oak" are left in English; use "daun kering beech (Fagus), ek" or similar.
Item 5: "aufwuchs" is left untranslated with no gloss; add "(lapisan alga dan mikroorganisme)".
Item 5: "setup" is used repeatedly; "tata letak akuarium" or "aquascape" is more natural.

acanthocobitis-zonalternans.name: Zipper Loach
notes: Item 2: the neotype locality quote is left in English ('4 kilometers south of Amphoe Mae Ramat on road 1085 ... Tak Province, Salween basin, Thailand'). Translate the descriptive words, e.g. '4 kilometer di selatan Amphoe Mae Ramat di jalan 1085 ... Provinsi Tak, cekungan Salween, Thailand'. Keep the place names.
Item 5: 'daun kering beech, oak' leaves the English names in place. Use 'daun beech (Fagus) dan ek' or add a short gloss.
Item 5: 'setup' and 'hill stream' stay in English. 'Setup' is common, but 'tata letak/penataan akuarium' and 'akuarium tipe sungai pegunungan berarus' read more naturally.
Item 5: 'aufwuchs' is left untranslated. Add a gloss such as 'aufwuchs (lapisan alga dan biofilm)'.

acanthopsoides-molobrion.name: Dwarf Horse-faced Loach
notes: Item 11: "seorang hobiis, Mark Duffill" names a forum member and drops the "SF member" attribution; consider a neutral "seorang hobiis" without the name.
Item 12: "Lokasi tipe" and "duri sub-okular" are stiff; "lokalitas tipe" and "duri di bawah mata" read more naturally.
Item 12: "Ikan hias" is fine, but "tuberkel kawin" and "kromatofor" could use a short gloss for hobbyist readers.

acanthopsoides-robertsi.name: Dwarf Horseface Loach
notes: "5,2 sampai 7,2 dalam panjang kepala" and "2 sampai 2,5 dalam panjang kepala" read awkwardly. Rephrase as "5,2–7,2 kali dalam panjang kepala" or "panjang kepala 5,2–7,2 kali diameter mata".
"batu yang halus terkikis air" is clumsy. Use "batu yang halus karena terkikis air" or "batu sungai yang halus".
"bintil-bintil kawin kecil (breeding tubercle)": "bintil pemijahan" is more usual; the bracketed English is fine.
"danau tapal kuda" for oxbow is acceptable but could be "danau tapal kuda (oxbow)" or "kolam bekas meander sungai" for clarity.

acantopsis-dialuzona.name: Horseface loach
notes: Item 12: "sirip ekor yang sedikit bercabang" and "sirip ekor bercabang atau berlekuk dalam" translate "forked" with "bercabang". That also means "branched" (as in branched rays), so it is ambiguous. Use "bercagak" or "berpangkal dua" instead.
Item 3: "sebagian besar (kalaupun ada)" renders "a significant percentage (if any)" as "most", which is stronger than the source. Use "persentase yang signifikan (kalaupun ada)".
Item 3: "dari setiap kajian yang mendetail" is a bit loose. Use "dari kajian yang mendetail".
Item 6: "batu yang tergerus air" is awkward for "water-worn rocks". Use "batu sungai yang halus terkikis air" or "batu kali".

acrochordonichthys-gyrinus.name: Falcate Chameleon Catfish
notes: "teman setangki" (items 1, 8) is slightly unnatural. "ikan penghuni akuarium yang sama" or "tankmate" would be more usual for Indonesian hobbyists.
"tanpa lipatan daging" (item 9) is a bit literal for "fleshy flap". "tanpa lipatan berdaging" reads more naturally.

acrochordonichthys-rugosus.name: Asian Banjo Catfish
notes: Item 2/16: "Risiko Rendah (Least Concern)" is a slightly non-standard rendering of the IUCN category. "Berisiko Rendah" or "Risiko Rendah" with the English term is acceptable, but keep it consistent with the Indonesian IUCN usage.
Item 7: "kimia air yang naik-turun" is a bit stiff. Consider "parameter air yang berfluktuasi".
Item 8: "Kayu dan akar yang sudah lama terendam" for "Aged driftwood" slightly shifts the meaning. Consider "kayu apung yang sudah matang/tua (driftwood)".
Item 12: "Meskipun sebenarnya tidak suka bergerombol" is a bit stronger than "not really gregarious". Consider "kurang bersifat bergerombol".

acrochordonichthys-septentrionalis.name: Mae Klong Chameleon Catfish
notes: "stres dalam bentuk tertentu" is stiff and slightly unclear for "stressed in some way". Use "mengalami stres/tertekan oleh sebab tertentu".
"batu dan kerikil sungai yang halus terkikis air" is awkward for "water-worn rocks and pebbles". Use "batu dan kerikil sungai yang bulat/halus terkikis air", or simply "batu dan kerikil sungai".
"pori aksila" is very technical. Consider adding the English term in brackets, "pori aksila (axillary pore)".
"pengaturan seperti ini membantu" is a loose rendering of "such an arrangement provides assistance". Use "pengelompokan seperti ini membantu".
"Seperti kerabatnya satu genus" is clumsy. Use "Seperti spesies lain dalam genusnya".

agamyxis-pectinifrons.name: Raphael tutul
notes: Item 1: 'Max size: 150 mm SL (6 in)' became '15 cm SL' – fine, but item 3 'Polygonium sp.' etc unchanged; no issue. Real issue in item 4: volume stated as 'sekitar 108 liter' with no tank height given; acceptable. Main issue: item 2 'Region Loreto' should be 'Wilayah/Departemen Loreto' (Region is untranslated English).
Item 2: 'Batas pasti sebaran alaminya masih agak belum jelas' is awkward; use 'masih kurang jelas'.
Item 2: 'Lokasi tipe' should be 'lokalitas tipe' (standard taxonomic term); 'Equador' in the quote is fine.

Item 3: 'mengalir 'sedimen terlarut membuat air keruh' – source says 'reducing visibility'; fine, but 'polong-polongan' for 'leguminous species' is okay. 'padang apung' is a coined term; keep English in brackets only once consistently.

Item 7: 'omnivora generalis' is stiff; use 'omnivora dan tidak pemilih (generalis)'. 'Tubifex' translated as 'cacing sutra' is OK but 'pakan buatan' for 'prepared foods' should be 'pakan olahan/pabrikan'.
Item 11: 'sisik keras (scute)' – scutes are bony plates, not scales; use 'lempeng tulang (scute)'. 'klad' is unusual; use 'kelompok monofiletik (clade)'.
Item 11: 'memperkeras suara' mistranslates 'projection of the noise'; should be 'memancarkan/menyalurkan suara'.
Item 11: 'kerabat segenusnya' – 'congener' fine; but 'Region'/'lele driftwood' fine. 'konon' for 'ostensibly' adds hearsay nuance; use 'tampaknya/dengan alasan'.

akysis-ephippifer.name: Akysis ephippifer
notes: "mudah dipelihara oleh penghobi yang cukup berpengalaman": "any decent fishkeeper" means almost any reasonably competent keeper; consider "penghobi yang kompeten/pada umumnya" so it doesn't imply experience is required.
"dalam 30 cm": for tank depth, use "panjang/lebar depan-belakang" or "kedalaman" more naturally, e.g. "30 cm (lebar) x 20 cm (tinggi) x 30 cm (dalam)" could be clearer.
"gua": hobbyists usually say "gua-gua kecil" or "shelter/tempat sembunyi"; the plural "caves" is not reflected.
"sirip ekor yang sedikit berlekuk (emarginate)": "emarginate" means a shallow notch; "sedikit" is acceptable, but "berlekuk dangkal" is more precise.
"Data Deficient (Kekurangan Data)": the standard Indonesian IUCN term is "Data Kurang"; use "Data Kurang (Data Deficient)".
"kutu air" for daphnia: hobbyists often use "kutu air" for Daphnia, though "Daphnia" is also common; this is fine but could add "(daphnia)".

akysis-hendricksoni.name: Hendrickson's Stream Catfish
notes: Item 19: "Wakil Rektor" for "Vice-Chancellor" is a questionable equivalent (a vice-chancellor is closer to a rector or head). Use "Rektor" or "Wakil Kanselir", or keep the English title.
Item 14: "hillstream loach dari famili Balitoridae" adds "hillstream", which is not in the source. Use "lohok/loach balitorid" or "famili Balitoridae" only.
Item 5: "sungai kecil yang cukup besar (lebar sekitar 10 m)" is contradictory and awkward. Use "anak sungai yang cukup lebar (sekitar 10 m)" or just "sungai".
Item 9: "penghobi yang cukup berpengalaman" reads more demanding than "any decent fishkeeper". Use "penghobi yang kompeten" or "penghobi pada umumnya".
Item 8: "moss" is left in English. Use "lumut (moss)" or "berbagai jenis lumut air".
Item 19: "kysis = kantong" for "bladder" is imprecise. "Kandung" or "kantung" would be better, since the reference is to the swim bladder.
Item 12: "jentik kaca (glassworm)" is a loose rendering of the glassworm (Chaoborus larva). Hobbyists usually say "cacing kaca" or "jentik lonceng/kaca", so check the term.

akysis-heterurus.name: Lele Akysis
notes: Item 4: "depan-belakang 30 cm" is awkward for tank depth; use "dalam 30 cm" or "lebar 30 cm x tinggi 20 cm x dalam 30 cm".
Item 4: "gua-gua kecil sebagai tempat bersembunyi" adds "kecil" and "sebagai tempat bersembunyi", which the source does not say; use "gua" only.
Item 3: the gloss after "unculiferous" ("yaitu tonjolan kecil yang permukaannya dipenuhi tonjolan halus seperti kait") is not in the source; remove it or shorten it to "berunculi".

akysis-maculipinnis.name: Spotfin Stream Catfish
notes: Item 14: "alur-alur melingkar di sekitar lubangnya" for "radial grooves" is wrong, because melingkar means circular. Use "alur-alur yang memancar dari lubangnya" or similar.
Item 8: "moss", "beech" and "oak" are left in English. Use "lumut" or "moss" with a gloss, and "daun beech/ek" with a gloss.
Item 15: "air yang sudah diendapkan" for "aged water" is slightly off. "air yang sudah didiamkan/diendapkan (aged)" is more natural, and "diffuser" could get a local gloss.
Item 13: "wajib cari tahu dulu dengan benar" is colloquial for a handbook. Use "wajib dipelajari dulu dengan cermat".

akysis-pulvinatus.name: Kra stream catfish
notes: "betina yang sedang bertelur" for "gravid female": gravid means carrying eggs, not yet spawning. Use "betina yang sedang bunting telur" or "penuh telur".
"alur-alur melingkar di sekitar lubangnya" for "radial grooves at the pore": radial means grooves radiating outward. Use "alur-alur yang memancar dari lubang".
"batu-batu sungai yang halus" for "water-worn rocks": better as "batu sungai yang halus/membulat karena terkikis air".
Item 8: "hillstream loach (balitorid)" is fine, but "tumbuh terlalu besar" would read more naturally as "terlalu besar saat dewasa".

akysis-varius.name: Akysis varius
notes: Item 16: "Pola warna dewasa sudah terbentuk sempurna baru 23 hari kemudian" reverses the nuance. The English "after just 23 days" means it was fast, but "baru" reads as late. Use "hanya dalam 23 hari" or "sudah terbentuk sempurna hanya setelah 23 hari".
Items 1, 17, 18: "sirip ekor tegak (truncate)" is a questionable rendering. "Tegak" does not describe a caudal fin shape. Use "sirip ekor terpotong rata (truncate)".
Item 1: "Variable stream catfish" is left in English in the running text. Add a local gloss such as "lele sungai variabel" or keep it clearly marked as a trade name.
Item 17: "alat bisa (venom)" is awkward. "Kelenjar bisa" or "struktur penyuntik bisa" is more natural.

akysis-vespa.name: Wasp Catfish
notes: #8: "(misalnya lumut Java)" is not in the source. Delete it or keep only "berbagai jenis lumut".
#14: "hillstream loach dari famili Balitoridae" adds "hillstream", which the source doesn't have. Use "lonjong/loach balitorid" or "loach Balitoridae" without the addition.
#14: "Lele akysid lain ... direkomendasikan untuk lapisan bawah akuarium" is slightly awkward. "Ikan lele akysid" would be more natural.

allenbatrachus-grunniens.name: Ikan kodok
notes: Item 2: "menggerutu/mendengkur" for Latin 'grunting' is imprecise. Use "mendengus" or "menggeram" (grunting sound), and give one term rather than two.
Item 1: the opening "Freshwater toadfish" is left in English. Give an Indonesian name or gloss first, e.g. "Ikan kodok air tawar (freshwater toadfish)".
Item 5: "Spesies ini cukup umum di dunia akuarium" is slightly vague. "Dalam dunia akuarium hobi" or "di kalangan hobiis" would sound more natural.

amatitlania-nigrofasciata.name: Convict Cichlid
notes: Item 6: "Idealnya sedikit di atas netral (basa)" – "Somewhere on the alkaline side of neutral" means on the alkaline side; "sedikit" (slightly) adds a nuance, and the bracket is clumsy. Use "Idealnya di sisi basa dari netral".
Item 11: "burayaknya tidak mudah disalurkan" – "dispose of" means getting rid of or selling the fry; "disalurkan" is vague. Use "dijual atau dilepaskan" / "sulit dihabiskan".
Item 10: "Burayak" is used for the eggs' hatchlings and for free-swimming fry, and "Anakan" appears for the same young later. Keep the terms consistent.
Item 10: "Untuk ikan sekecil itu, mereka sangat agresif" – "sekecil itu" has no clear referent; use "Untuk ikan sekecil ini" / "seukuran ini".
Item 7: "kondisi ikan bisa berkembang optimal" – "kondisi berkembang" is awkward; use "agar kondisi ikan prima".
Item 10: "Kondisikan ikan" – the hobby term for conditioning broodstock is "dikondisikan/diberi pakan pematangan gonad"; "merangsang pemijahan" is fine.
Item 5: "kayu bogwood" is redundant; use "kayu bogwood (kayu apung/akar kayu)" or just "bogwood".
Item 1/11: "menjadi sangat ganas saat berbiak" – "berbiak" for fish is better as "memijah" for consistency with the rest of the text.

ambastaia-nigrolineata.name: Black-lined Loach
notes: Item 9: 'karena Ambastaia spp. ikan yang penuh rasa ingin tahu' lacks the copula; write 'merupakan ikan yang penuh rasa ingin tahu'.
Item 7: 'riam' for 'riffles' suggests rapids or waterfalls; 'bagian berarus deras dan dangkal' or 'riak' is closer.
Item 12: 'ikan lele' for 'catfishes' usually means Clarias; 'berbagai jenis catfish' or 'ikan berkumis' is better for ornamental catfish.

ambastaia-sidthimunki.name: Botia sidthimunki
notes: Item 6: "karena Ambastaia spp. ikan yang penasaran" is missing a verb. Write "karena Ambastaia spp. adalah ikan yang penasaran".
Item 11: "indukan dewasanya" adds the idea of breeders. The source says only "adult specimens", so use "ikan dewasanya".
Item 11: the report link ("available here") is turned into "Mark juga menulis laporan lengkap". The reader can no longer find the report, so keep a pointer to it.
Item 3: the acknowledgement "Thanks to Kamphol Udomritthiruj" is dropped. Restore it, or make sure the source credit is kept in the "K. Udomritthiruj, komunikasi pribadi" citation.
Item 12: "Pertunjukan seperti ini" for "Such displays" reads oddly. Use "Tampilan seperti ini" or "Perilaku semacam ini".
Item 6: "batu dan kerikil yang halus bekas tergerus air" is clumsy. Use "batu dan kerikil halus yang terkikis air".

amblypharyngodon-chulabhornae.name: Princess Carplet
notes: Item 5: "siklus nitrogennya belum matang" is fine, but "Paling cocok dipelihara" is a slight shift from "Best maintained"; acceptable. Main issue: "ikan ikutan (bycatch)" is unnatural; use "ikan tangkapan sampingan" or "ikan campuran yang ikut terbawa".
Item 1/3: "Princess carplet" left untranslated with no local name; consider adding a descriptive Indonesian rendering or keeping it in italics/quotes as a trade name.
Item 2: "Lokasi tipe" is fine, but the type locality text is left in English ("Province"); consider "Provinsi" or keep as a quoted citation consistently.
Item 4: "Panjang standar: 4 cm" drops the precision of 40 mm; write "40 mm (4 cm)" or "4,0 cm".
Item 5: "Filter tidak perlu terlalu kuat karena ikan ini kebanyakan berasal dari..." is slightly awkward; use "karena ikan ini umumnya berasal dari perairan yang tenang".
Item 8: "tidak mudah stres" replaces "less nervous" (more skittish); prefer "tidak mudah gugup/penakut".
Item 7: "kutu air" for Daphnia is acceptable but the common hobby term is "kutu air (Daphnia)"; consider keeping "Daphnia" explicitly.

amphilophus-labiatus.name: Red Devil
notes: Item 11: "belang" (barred) and "belang-belang tidak beraturan (piebald)" are too close to tell apart. Use "bergaris/berpita vertikal" for barred.
Item 5: "saat sedang heboh" is informal. Use something like "saat sedang sangat aktif/agresif".
Item 3: "limbah kotoran mentah" is awkward. Use "limbah tinja/kotoran mentah" or "limbah kotoran yang belum diolah".

anabas-testudineus.name: Ikan Betok
notes: Item 9: "mastacembelid (sidat/belut berduri)": sidat is Anguilla, a different fish. Use "tilan" or "belut duri".
Item 12: "peternakan komersial" for commercial farms: peternakan means livestock. Use "usaha budidaya ikan komersial" or "pembudidaya".
Item 12: "data deficient" is left in English quotes with a gloss. This is acceptable, but "data kurang (data deficient)" would read more naturally.

anentome-helena.name: Keong Assassin
notes: "loach atau buntal": acceptable, but could use common Indonesian names, e.g. "ikan botia atau buntal" for loaches.
"belalainya": "trunk" is better rendered as "proboscis"/"belalai" is fine; consider "probosis" only if needed (very minor).

aphyocharax-anisitsi.name: Bloodfin Tetra
notes: Item 5: "Volume: ±54 liter" — "±" is non-standard for approximate; use "sekitar 54 liter" or "~54 L".

Item 9: "gerombolan campuran" — "gerombolan" has a negative connotation (gang); hobbyists use "kelompok" or "shoal". Also "ikan Corydoras dan Loricariidae" — consider "lele Corydoras" and "Loricariidae kecil (lele pembersih)" for natural hobby usage.
Item 11: "filter spons kecil bertenaga aerator" — more natural: "filter spons kecil dengan tenaga udara (air-powered)".
Item 11: "Indukan sebaiknya dikondisikan" for "The fish" — fine, but "burayak" for fry is ok; "Anda" addresses the reader while the source uses "you" — acceptable.

Item 2: first paragraph repeats the jump/lid warning in the source; the translation preserves it, but "Ikan ini mungkin menggigiti sirip" is a bit stronger than "may nip" — consider "bisa menggigiti sirip".

apteronotus-albifrons.name: Black Ghost
notes: Item 8: "makin kurus dan akhirnya mati" adds a death outcome. The source says only "wastes away". Use "makin kurus" or "menyusut kondisinya".
Items 1 and 2: "separuh bagian utara" for "upper half" is acceptable, but "bagian utara" alone may be more natural. Paraguay is in the south, so the phrase is slightly inaccurate in the source too.

apteronotus-leptorhynchus.name: Brown Ghost Knifefish
notes: "rutin diimpor" for "regularly stocked": slightly shifts meaning (stocked = available in shops). Consider "rutin tersedia" or "rutin dijual".
"Apteronotus leptorhynchus berwarna keemasan" with no article or noun: reads awkwardly. Consider "seekor Apteronotus leptorhynchus ..." or add "ikan".

astronotus-ocellatus.name: Ikan Oscar
notes: Item 1: 'Ukuran maksimal: 35 cm SL' / 'mencapai 35 cm SL' – 350 mm = 35 cm is correct, no issue; but see other items.
Item 12: 'cacing sutra' for tubifex is acceptable, but 'karnivora sejati' for 'serious carnivores' is fine; main issue: 'Oscar sangat menuntut kualitas kimia air' is okay.
Item 14: 'pastikan tetap memilih jenis-jenis dari Amerika Selatan juga' is slightly awkward; better 'pilih hanya jenis dari Amerika Selatan'.
Item 17: 'enam ekor anakan atau lebih' – 'half-a-dozen or more' fine; 'burayak' for fry is acceptable but 'benih' is more common among hobbyists.

Item 18: 'dibuahi oleh jantan dengan berenang di atasnya' – original says male swims over to fertilize; acceptable. 'Oscar bisa pilih-pilih dalam memilih pasangan' is repetitive; use 'sangat selektif dalam memilih pasangan'.
Item 19: 'bersifat kamuflase' for 'cryptic' colour pattern is fine but inconsistent with 'kriptik' used elsewhere; 'tribus dugaan' is awkward, use 'tribus yang diduga (putative)'.
Item 2: 'Area berenang: Atas dan tengah' ok; the source 'Minimum tank size 65 gallons (about 250 litres)' conversion: 65 US gal ≈ 246 L, OK.
Item 18: '100 gallon (about 380 litres)' fine.
Item 12: 'cacing darah' for bloodworms fine; but 'Meskipun sebagian orang menyarankan... pakan hidup' fine. Item 3: 'Populasi liar hasil introduksi' fine.
Item 6: Omitted the US gallon conversion — fine per instructions.

astyanax-mexicanus.name: Blind Cave Tetra
notes: Item 10: "pada sore atau malam hari" adds "sore"; the source says only "in the evening" ("pada malam hari").
Item 10: "Biasanya mereka sudah memijah" adds "Biasanya" (usually), which softens the source's "They should have spawned". Use "Mereka seharusnya sudah memijah".
Items 5 and 10: "setup" is left as English. "Penataan akuarium" or "set-up" would be more natural.

atractosteus-spatula.name: Ikan aligator
notes: #2: "hingga ke selatan sampai negara bagian Veracruz" is redundant. Use "hingga ke selatan sampai negara bagian Veracruz" -> "hingga ke negara bagian Veracruz di selatan".

#8: "ikan yang tidak agresif dengan ukuran serupa yang tidak muat di mulutnya" is ambiguous because of the stacked "yang". Rephrase, e.g. "ikan non-agresif berukuran serupa yang terlalu besar untuk muat di mulutnya".

atyopsis-moluccensis.name: Udang bambu
notes: Item 2: "finely grated dry food" translated as "pakan kering yang dihaluskan" - acceptable, but "cyclops beku" could be clarified as "cyclops beku" (fine); "partikel melayang" for "floating material" is fine.
Item 3: "kipas tangannya" ("hand fans") is awkward; use "kipas di capitnya" or "kipas capit". Also "capit" for "claws" and "kaki jalan" are okay, but "ujung ... kaki jalan" for "end limbs" is vague.
Item 3: "diam di tempat yang berarus" is slightly awkward; better "menempatkan diri di aliran arus".
Item 5: "cukup merepotkan" is weaker than "connected with some expenditure" (butuh biaya/upaya cukup besar); consider "memerlukan upaya dan biaya tertentu".
Item 1/3: "Moluccan mountain rock shrimp" and "Gabon giant fan shrimp" left in English; consider adding Indonesian names (e.g., "udang kipas raksasa Gabon") with English in brackets.

bagrichthys-hypselopterus.name: Black Lancer
notes: Item 9: 'Although they possess a small mouth it is wide' is translated 'Mulutnya memang kecil tetapi lebar' - fine, but 'Meski begitu... tetapi kalau' is clumsy; the source says the fish is not a threat because of the mouth, so the logic is blurred. Rephrase more clearly.
Item 1: 'Least Concern' translated as 'Risiko Rendah' - the standard Indonesian term is 'Berisiko Rendah' or 'Resiko Rendah'; use consistently (also item 12).
Item 1: '400 mm or 15.7" SL' - the SL (standard length) is not explained; consider 'panjang standar (SL)'.

Item 12: 'hypselopterus berarti bersirip tinggi atau panjang' - source says 'deep or long finned'; acceptable but 'nama genus ini hanya dipakai' wrongly repeats 'genus' where source speaks of the name 'bagre' being used - clarify that 'bagre' is the word used for African and Asian species.
Item 12: '247000 km2' should be written '247.000 km²' in Indonesian number format.
Item 7: 'memakan detritus' is OK but 'detritivorous' implies a detritivore; use 'pemakan detritus (detritivor)'.
Item 1 vs 2: Common name 'Black Lancer Catfish' left in English while item 9 uses 'Black lancer' - keep consistent.
Item 3/4: 'in fluviis' left untranslated Latin phrase; fine, but add '(di sungai-sungai)' for readers.

bagrichthys-obscurus.name: Black Lancer obscurus
notes: Item 15: "Keep a single male alongside 3 or more females" is rendered "3 betina atau lebih" - fine, but "seharusnya membantu ... terus-menerus menjadi sasaran" adds "terus-menerus" (continuously), which is not in the source; remove it.

Item 7: "Volume: sekitar 243 liter" - 120×45 cm base with no height given; the figure is carried over from the source. The imperial "48 × 18 in" was correctly dropped, so no change is needed there. Check that the volume is plausible.

Item 1/20: "serrae" translated as "gerigi" and "crenulated" as "bergerigi halus" - the same word is used for two different structures. Use "gerigi/serrasi" for serrae and "berkerut/bergelombang" for crenulated.

Item 20: "genital papilla in males touching the first anal-fin ray" is rendered "menyentuh jari-jari pertama sirip anal" - should be the singular "jari-jari pertama" (the first ray), not plural "jari-jari".
Item 13: "Tubifex" rendered as "cacing sutra" - fine, but "Artemia" is left lowercase; minor.

Item 18: "Not reported in aquaria; there is no breeding report" is rendered as "Belum pernah dilaporkan berkembang biak di akuarium" - slightly changes meaning, since the source says the species is not reported in aquaria at all.
Item 8: "Heater" is left in English; "pemanas" is the more common Indonesian term.
Item 14/15: "Conspecifics may be aggressively territorial" and "sesama jenis" are fine, but "teritorial yang agresif" is awkward.

bangana-behri.name: Incisilabeo
notes: #2 'Ukurannya bisa mencapai 450 hingga 550 mm': keep as is or convert to cm (45–55 cm); mixing mm with cm elsewhere is inconsistent.
#2/#5 'bermigrasi ke hulu Sungai Sekong': 'up the ... rivers' is fine, but 'siprinid' is non-standard; use 'ikan famili Cyprinidae' or 'ikan karper'.
#14 'nama persembahan untuk Otto Behr': awkward; use 'nama untuk menghormati Otto Behr'.
#14 'Bersama Bangana behri, didatangkan juga Labeo pierrei': 'came along with' is vague; the added 'didatangkan' is acceptable but could be clearer as 'ikut masuk dalam kiriman yang sama'.
#1 'Nama umum: Two-headed carp': add an Indonesian gloss or keep as the trade name; the 'tonjolan seperti tanduk' for 'horn' weakens the source.
#15 'Tubuh dan kepalanya juga tampak sangat tinggi': 'deep' means body depth; use 'tubuh dan kepalanya sangat tinggi (pipih tegak)', and the phrase 'tampak' is added.
#15 'mengesahkan kembali Incisilabeo': use 'menghidupkan kembali/memvalidasi kembali' for taxonomic revalidation.

barbodes-semifasciolatus.name: Chinese barb
notes: #12: "Indukan akan dengan mudah memakan telurnya" is stiff. Use "Indukan cenderung memakan telurnya" or "akan langsung memakan telurnya".
#24: "pemijah bebas penyebar telur yang tidak menunjukkan pengasuhan induk" is clumsy. Use "pemijah penyebar telur yang tidak menjaga telur maupun anaknya".
#24: "mikroworm" is half-translated. Use "cacing mikro (microworm)" or "microworm" in italics.
#4: "punggung yang melengkung curam" is a loose rendering of "steeply-sloped back". Use "punggung yang menanjak curam" or "bagian punggung yang miring tajam".

barbonymus-altus.name: Red Tail Tinfoil Barb
notes: Item 4: '(8 in)' and '(60 × 24 in)' and '(~143 US gal)' dropped. Metric conversion is fine, but 'Standard length: 210 mm SL (8 in)' is already metric, so this is acceptable; no real issue except 'SL' left without explanation.

Item 5: 'koloni bakteri yang diinginkan' misattaches 'desired' (levels of oxygen, flow and surface area are what is desired); rephrase to 'tingkat oksigen, arus, dan luas permukaan yang diinginkan untuk koloni bakteri'.
Item 5: 'mudah kaget' for 'skittish' is fine, but 'kadang cukup' is vague; minor.
Item 7: 'zukini yang sudah direbus sebentar' fine; 'kutu air' for Daphnia is acceptable but 'Daphnia' is the usual hobby term, so keep Daphnia/kutu air.
Item 8: 'Hasilnya, tampilan akuarium akan jauh lebih alami, plus perilaku ...' is awkward; 'plus' is colloquial. Rephrase to 'serta perilaku ikan yang menarik'.
Item 8: 'mudah kaget atau bahkan agresif' for 'skittish' acceptable; 'cara makannya yang cukup beringas' is a bit strong for 'rather vigorous feeding behaviour'; use 'cukup agresif/bersemangat'.
Item 10: 'menghasilkan anakan dalam jumlah besar' – 'broods' fine; 'penyebar telur' acceptable but 'egg-scatterer' is usually 'penyebar telur (egg scatterer)'.
Item 11: 'Banyak pemilik toko akan bilang' is colloquial; use 'akan mengatakan'.
Item 11: 'sirip perut' for pelvic fins is fine; no change.
Item 2/3: 'Pada bulan-bulan yang lebih basah ini' is slightly awkward; use 'pada bulan-bulan basah tersebut'.

barbronia-weberi.name: Lintah Asia
notes: "Alat isap" for suckers: the standard zoological term is "batil isap" (anterior/posterior).
"udang hias kerdil" for dwarf shrimp is stilted. Use "dwarf shrimp" or "udang hias"/"udang kerdil".

belontia-hasselti.name: Selincah
notes: Item 10: "sangat subur" for "very fecund" is imprecise. Use something like "menghasilkan banyak telur".
Item 10: "dengan jantan yang menjaga telur" narrows "paternal" to egg guarding. Use "jantan yang mengasuh telur dan anakan" or "pengasuhan oleh jantan".
Item 3: "kerabat murad" for Melaleuca (myrtle) is vague. Consider "Melaleuca (famili Myrtaceae/gelam)".
Item 5: "Buah alder (alder cone)" is awkward. Consider "kerucut alder" or "kerucut pohon alder".

betta-albimarginata.name: Betta albimarginata
notes: Item 17: "more vigorous fishes" is rendered as "lebih agresif". This slightly changes the meaning. "lebih aktif/tangkas" is closer.
Item 10: "mengakses lapisan udara" is stiff. "mengambil napas dari lapisan udara" would read more naturally.

betta-anabatoides.name: Betta anabatoides
notes: Item 6: "bisa mencapai panjang sekitar 12,5 cm" turns "up to 5 inches" into an approximation; "hingga 12,5 cm" or "mencapai 12,5 cm" is closer.
Item 2: "cukup toleran" softens "more tolerant"; "lebih toleran" would be more literal.

betta-burdigala.name: Betta burdigala
notes: Item 4: IUCN status 'Vulnerable' ('Rentan') since 1996 conflicts with item 1 'Critically Endangered' ('Kritis'). This is a source inconsistency, so keep each as written, but check the source.
Item 1: 'tangkapan alam' is fine, but 'Betta uberis tetapi tanpa bintik di bagian tengah tubuh' is an acceptable rendering. Not a problem.

Item 6: the original gives '1.2 - 1.5 inches (about 3-3.8 cm)'. Using 'sekitar' is fine. However, '1 pasang per 5 gallons' is rendered as 'per sekitar 19 liter'; 5 US gallons is about 19 L, so this is correct. No change needed.

Item 17: 'Floating plants may be incorporated into the nest' is rendered 'tanaman apung... mungkin dimasukkan ke dalam sarang'. This wrongly suggests the keeper adds them. Say instead that the male may incorporate floating plants into the nest, e.g. 'dapat disertakan jantan dalam sarang'.

Item 17: 'sperma' for 'milt' is acceptable, but 'mengalami masalah kesehatan jika diberi naupli artemia berlebihan' drops 'young Betta... reports exist' nuance. Reword to 'ada laporan bahwa Betta muda mengalami masalah kesehatan bila diberi naupli artemia berlebihan'.
Item 7: the SL conversion '1.4 in' was dropped, which is fine. No issue.

Item 5: 'sepanjang tahun' in the last sentence is slightly added ('karena air tidak selalu tersedia sepanjang tahun'). The original says 'permanent water is not always available', so use 'air permanen tidak selalu tersedia'.
Item 17: 'induk biasanya bisa dibiarkan tetap di akuarium' is OK. 'Dasar perairan' is fine.
Item 18: 'sisik postdorsal', 'predorsal' and 'subdorsal' are left as English terms; use Indonesian-style 'sisik di depan/belakang sirip punggung' if possible.

betta-dimidiata.name: Betta dimidiata
notes: Item 8: "sekitar 41 liter" is fine, but item 20: "jantan mengerami... sebelum disemburkan ke air untuk ditangkap jantan" is OK; real issue below.

Item 20: "burayak Betta mengalami masalah kesehatan jika terlalu banyak diberi artemia" turns "reports of" into a flat statement; keep it hedged, e.g. "ada laporan bahwa burayak Betta bisa mengalami masalah kesehatan bila terlalu banyak diberi artemia".
Item 20: "kecuali ikan sudah dipelihara tanpa ikan lain" is awkward and unclear; use "kecuali ikan memang sudah dipelihara sendiri (tanpa spesies lain)".

Item 20: "Telur yang sudah dibuahi ditampung di sirip anal jantan, lalu dipungut ke mulut betina" is correct, but "Setelah semua telur berada di mulut jantan... sampai telur betina habis" is fine; "burayak... sudah terbentuk sempurna" is OK. Item 9: "mengakses lapisan udara" reads stiffly; use "sesekali perlu mengambil udara dari lapisan udara lembap".
Item 7: "karena air tidak selalu tersedia sepanjang tahun" adds "sepanjang tahun"; the English says permanent water is not always available ("air permanen tidak selalu tersedia").
Item 2/22: the claim "mudah dibedakan" is fine, but item 2 "sirip ekornya bisa membedakan keduanya" is awkward; use "sirip ekornya yang membedakan keduanya".
Item 5: "danau-danau Danau Sentarum" is redundant; use "kawasan Danau Sentarum".
Item 12: "Aliran air yang lembut atau nyaris tanpa arus lebih disukai" is clumsy; use "Lebih disukai aliran air yang pelan atau nyaris tanpa arus".
Item 19: "Burayak yang baru dilepaskan bisa langsung makan" is fine, but "pelukan percumbuan" is unnatural; use "pelukan saat berpacaran".
Item 10: "Air blackwater yang lunak dan asam adalah yang ideal" is stiff; use "Idealnya air blackwater yang lunak dan asam".

betta-edithae.name: Betta edithae
notes: Item 1: 'Ukuran maksimal: sekitar 5,8 cm' is fine, but the 'much better coloration ... above 78°F (about 26°C)' line is rendered 'di atas sekitar 26 °C'. This is acceptable, so no change is needed here. The real problem is item 2/19: the sentence 'membran branchiostegal dan bagian belakang operkulum ... yang buram atau tembus cahaya' is fine.

Item 5: 'sekitar Palembang di Provinsi Sumatera Selatan, Sumatra' changes the source's 'near Palembang'. It also reads as if the province is 'Sumatra'. Rephrase to: 'di dekat Palembang (Provinsi Sumatera Selatan, Pulau Sumatra)'.

Item 7: the '60 mm SL (2.4 in SL)' conversion was dropped, which is fine. However '80 × 30 cm ... sekitar 72 liter' keeps the source's volume without the tank height, so it is not verifiable. Check it against the source.

Item 8: 'Buah alder (Alnus)' should be 'kerucut/buah alder (Alnus)'. 'Alder cones' are strobili, not fruit. Also 'ikan ini juga pelompat yang ulung' is slightly awkward. Better: 'dan pandai melompat'.
Item 8: 'filter spons bertenaga aerator' is fine. 'Mikroba ini bisa menjadi sumber pakan' changes the referent: the source says 'These' (the microbe colonies), which is acceptable.
Item 12: 'kutu air' for Daphnia is acceptable. 'Isi perut serangga tersebut dulu' is ambiguous. Rephrase to 'beri makan serangga itu dulu dengan serpihan ikan atau sayuran sebelum diberikan ke ikan'.
Item 13: 'sangat damai' is ok, but the duplicated sentence mirrors the source. No change is needed.

Item 18: 'Telur yang sudah dibuahi ditangkap di sirip anal jantan, lalu dipungut ke mulut betina' is faithful. 'Burayak ... microworm dan naupli artemia' is also fine. But 'anakan Betta ... jika diberi naupli artemia' reads as if the problem was with artemia only, which is correct. Also 'peternak' for 'breeders' is fine. 'plastik wrap' is acceptable.
Item 4: 'kompleks Betta edithae' is acceptable, but the source's 'group' is used inconsistently. Use 'kelompok Betta edithae' to match items 2 and 19.
Item 20: the references are untranslated, as instructed.

betta-hendra.name: Betta hendra
notes: Item 20: 'Pasangan tidak perlu dipisahkan sebelum memijah' is fine, but 'Floating plants may be incorporated into the nest' became 'Tanaman apung mungkin dimasukkan ke dalam sarang' – it is the male who incorporates them, so say 'Jantan dapat menyertakan tanaman apung ke dalam sarang'.

Item 20: 'Offer small amounts of different foods' is rendered 'sedikit pakan yang beragam', which is fine. But 'fry are large enough to accept motile foods ... immediately' is rendered OK; 'adults do not usually eat their offspring' is OK. 'Setelah memijah, induk biasanya bisa dibiarkan di tempat' is vague; clarify 'tetap di akuarium pemijahan'.

Item 22: 'The former ... name' / 'the latter' were mistranslated as 'Nama pertama' and 'nama kedua'. The 'latter' refers to B. sp. 'Palangka', but the Indonesian 'Ejaan nama kedua' is ambiguous; say 'Ejaan nama Palangka kemudian dikoreksi'.

Item 22: 'Anggota kelompok B. coccina ... (up to 40 mm, 1.6 in SL)' – 'SL' is left unexplained, so add 'panjang standar (SL)'. 'penghuni stenotipik rawa gambut hutan' reads awkwardly; use 'penghuni khas rawa gambut hutan'.
Item 22: 'kelompok dugaan' for 'putative groups' is unnatural; use 'kelompok yang diduga/diusulkan'.
Item 7: 'kerabat satu genusnya' is awkward for 'congener'; use 'sesama genus Betta'. 'nyaris nol' for 'negligible' mineral content is acceptable but slightly overstated.
Item 19: 'Percumbuan' and 'baby artemia' are slightly unnatural; use 'pacaran/ritual pemijahan' and 'naupli artemia'.
Item 23: References are left in English, as instructed, so there is no issue.
Item 9: 'pelompat yang andal' is an odd way to say 'excellent jumper'; use 'pelompat ulung'. The 'Seperti semua Betta spp.' phrasing is fine.

betta-ideii.name: Betta ideii
notes: Item 2: "memicu munculnya warna dan perilaku memijah" is slightly awkward; consider "memicu warna yang lebih cerah dan perilaku berbiak".

betta-imbellis.name: Cupang imbellis
notes: Item 1: 'Maximum size: 2.3 inches (about 6 cm)' is fine, but 'Least Concern (risiko rendah)' is OK; no issue. Real issue is item 19: 'sperma' for milt is acceptable, but 'sampai telur betina habis' is a loose paraphrase of 'until the female is spent'; use 'sampai betina selesai mengeluarkan seluruh telurnya'.

Item 19: 'sementara jantan terus memungut dan mengembalikan burayak yang jatuh' - the English says the male collects eggs that fall ('any that fall'), and the eggs are hatching, so 'burayak' is acceptable; but 'Telur menetas ... lalu tetap berada di sarang' means the hatched fry stay, so 'telur' is wrongly the subject. Rewrite as 'Telur menetas dalam 24–48 jam, dan burayak tetap berada di sarang 3–4 hari berikutnya'.
Item 8: the English gives 'about 41 litres' for a 45 × 30 cm base and the translation keeps it. Check that the figure is right, since the tank height is not stated.
Item 9: 'tropical lilies' is rendered 'teratai tropis'. This is fine. 'Cryptocoryne spp. juga pilihan yang baik' is missing the verb 'merupakan'. Rephrase as 'juga merupakan pilihan yang baik'.
Item 14: 'non-male betta mates' is rendered 'pasangan cupang yang bukan jantan'. 'Mates' means tankmates here, so use 'teman satu akuarium', not 'pasangan', which suggests breeding partners.
Item 20: 'Anabantoidei' is called a 'subordo'. The English also says suborder, so this matches. 'suprabranchial' and 'epibranchial' are left unchanged, which is acceptable.
Item 13: 'chironomid larvae (bloodworm)' is rendered 'larva chironomid (cacing darah)'. Use the common 'jentik/cacing darah (larva Chironomus)'. This is minor.

betta-livida.name: Betta livida
notes: Item 1: 'Ikan ini anggota berwarna merah dari kelompok B. coccina' is missing the verb 'adalah' and reads awkwardly. Also 'status terancam punah (endangered)' is fine, but 'sarang busa' for a labyrinth fish is OK.
Item 8: 'ikan ini juga pelompat yang sangat andal' – 'andal' (reliable) is the wrong nuance for 'excellent jumper'. Use 'pelompat ulung' or 'sangat pandai melompat'.

Item 8: 'Tanaman air ... bisa ditambahkan' drops the 'You could add' framing, which is minor. 'filter spons bertenaga aerator yang diatur agar airnya berputar pelan' is clumsy; use 'filter spons dengan aerator yang diatur pelan'.

Item 16: 'Jika ada tanaman apung, tanaman itu mungkin ikut dijadikan bagian dari sarang' is OK, but 'Gunakan tutup akuarium yang serapat mungkin' is fine. 'larva tetap berada di sarang' adds the word 'larva' where the English says 'eggs remaining in the nest' (the eggs hatch, so the meaning is not clearly the same). Say 'telur/larva'.
Item 16: 'sperma dan beberapa butir telur dikeluarkan' – 'milt' is better as 'cairan sperma/air mani jantan'. Also 'ikan dewasa ... tidak memakan anaknya' is fine.

Item 18: 'jari-jari sirip anal', 'sisik subdorsal' are fine, but 'hanya hidup di rawa gambut hutan' for 'stenotypic' loses the meaning that it is restricted to this habitat. 'Sirip perut' for pelvic fin is fine.
Item 2: 'Betta' is rendered 'cupang' here but kept as 'Betta' elsewhere. Keep the term consistent across entries.
Item 11: 'kutu air' for Daphnia is acceptable, but 'kutu air' may be confused with other things. Consider 'Daphnia (kutu air)'.

betta-mahachaiensis.name: Betta Mahachai
notes: Item 14: "mengalahkannya dalam berebut makanan" adds "makanan" (food), which the English "outcompete it" doesn't say. Use a more neutral wording such as "menyisihkannya dalam persaingan".
Item 18: "larva tetap di sarang" is fine, but "anakan Betta" and "burayak" are used interchangeably for fry. Use one term consistently.

betta-mandor.name: Betta mandor
notes: Item 11: 'carbonate hardness ... negligible' translated as 'kesadahan karbonat yang nyaris nol' - slightly stronger than 'negligible'; use 'sangat rendah/dapat diabaikan'.
Item 19: 'Fry ... can take ... immediately' fine, but 'Betta mandor adalah pengeram mulut, dan yang mengerami adalah jantan' is clumsy; use 'pengeram mulut paternal (jantan yang mengerami)'.
Item 9: 'Cryptocoryne spp.' and 'Betta spp.' left as 'spp.' fine, but 'Kerucut alder (alder cone)' is unclear; use 'buah alder/kerucut pohon alder' and explain.
Item 9: 'biologically-immature aquaria' rendered 'siklus nitrogennya belum matang' - adds a specific concept; better 'akuarium yang belum matang secara biologis'.
Item 20: 'bubble-nesters' rendered 'Betta pembuat sarang busa' - ok, but 'Jantan yang ... stres atau belum berpengalaman' and 'burayak' used for fry at release; fine. 'Cacing mikro' fine.
Item 2/22: 'twin red bars on the opercle' rendered 'dua garis merah di tutup insang' - 'bars' better as 'pita/garis vertikal'.
Item 6: 'kolam-kolam' for 'pools' suggests ponds; use 'genangan'.
Item 22: 'interradial membranes' as 'selaput antarjari' - use 'selaput antar jari-jari sirip'; 'zat humat' vs 'asam humat' inconsistent across items.
Item 16: 'more vigorous' as 'lebih aktif dan lincah' adds nuance; use 'lebih tangkas/agresif'.
Item 13: 'daphnia' as 'kutu air' is ok but 'Daphnia' elsewhere; keep consistent.

betta-miniopinna.name: Betta miniopinna
notes: Item 3: "lokasi spesifiknya belum diketahui" slightly changes "no specific location at this time" (not given/recorded). Use "belum ada keterangan lokasi spesifik".
Item 5: type locality is left in English inside the quote. Consider giving the Indonesian place names, e.g. "Kepulauan Riau, Bintan utara".

betta-ocellata.name: Betta ocellata
notes: Item 1: "Ukuran maksimum: 7,6 cm lebih" is wrong. English says "3+ inches (about 7.6 cm)" but item 2 says 90 mm SL. Use "lebih dari 7,6 cm" or "7,6 cm+".
Item 5: "sekitar 72 liter" is the converted volume, and the 31 × 12 in bracket was dropped. The conversion is fine, so no change is needed unless precision is wanted.
Item 7: "22–28 °C" is a rounded conversion of 72–82°F (22.2–27.8 °C), which is acceptable. "memunculkan warna" is awkward; use "memperkuat warna" or "memunculkan warna cerah".

Item 12: "kalah bersaing dengannya" and "mengintimidasinya" are ambiguous and stiff. Rephrase, e.g. "ikan ini akan terintimidasi dan kalah bersaing". "lebih agresif" for "more vigorous" changes the meaning slightly; use "lebih lincah/aktif".
Item 11: the sentence "yang berisi betta-betta terbesar" is awkward. Say clearly that the complex contains the largest bettas.
Item 16: "Akuarium harus memakai tutup serapat mungkin" is acceptable. "burayak" for fry is correct, but "Proses pendekatan (courtship)" is vague; "pacaran/penjajakan" is more usual.
Item 6: "filter spons bertenaga aerator" is fine. "mengakses lapisan udara" is stiff; use "mengambil udara dari lapisan udara lembap".
Item 18: the reference list is left untranslated, as instructed, so there is no issue.

betta-pallifina.name: Betta pallifina
notes: Item 2: "Maximum size: 3+ inches (about 8 cm)" became "sekitar 8 cm lebih"; the "3+" sense is muddled. Write "lebih dari 8 cm" or "8 cm lebih" more clearly.
Item 2: "Males and females both have colorful blue-teal fins" became "biru-toska". Teal is closer to "hijau kebiruan", so use that.

Item 15: "Ideally organise a separate tank... setting this up as suggested above" became "dan atur seperti yang disarankan di atas". It is ambiguous, so say the tank should be set up as described above.

Item 15: "Both adults have been observed to collect fertilised eggs" is fine. But "Karena itu banyak breeder membiarkan betina..." and "Namun... sehingga tetap harus dipindahkan" change the logic slightly. "Betina bisa terlalu mengganggu jantan" is fine, but "burayak" is wrongly used for the free-swimming young. That is acceptable, though "anakan" is also common.

Item 13: "Sebaiknya dipelihara di akuarium khusus satu spesies, karena ikan ini bisa memakan apa saja" is okay. In item 12, "bisa dijadikan teman" is a loose rendering of "compatible"; use "cocok dipelihara bersama".
Item 6: "3.5 in SL" was dropped, which is acceptable as a unit conversion. "Panjang standar 90 mm SL" is fine.
Item 10: "kutu air" for Daphnia is common, but the Latin name "Daphnia" is better kept. "Artemia" is fine.
Item 1: "Asalnya dari daerah terpencil di hulu DAS Barito" is fine. But in item 2 the status "Data Deficient" is left in English with a gloss, which is acceptable.

betta-patoti.name: Betta patoti
notes: Item 1: 'Genting (Endangered)' is a Malaysian-style term. Indonesian IUCN usage is 'Terancam Punah (Endangered)'.
Item 9: 'blackworms' as 'cacing sutra' is imprecise. Cacing sutra is tubifex, and blackworm (Lumbriculus) is a different worm. Use 'cacing hitam (blackworm)'.
Item 16: 'plastik wrap' for clingfilm is slightly awkward. 'Plastik pembungkus makanan' or 'plastic wrap' would read better.

betta-raja.name: Betta raja
notes: #20: "stagnant ditches" is rendered "parit berair tenang"; "parit berair menggenang/tergenang" is closer to the meaning.
#9 and #4: "peternak" for breeders sounds like livestock farmers. "Penangkar" or "breeder" is the term hobbyists use.

betta-rubra.name: Betta rubra
notes: Item 18: "(sirip punggung, anal, dan ekor)" is added; the English says only "unpaired fins". Remove the bracket or say "sirip tunggal" only.
Item 7: "genangan air hitam yang tergenang" is redundant. Use "kolam air hitam yang tergenang".
Item 21: "bar-like marking" is translated "tanda berbentuk balok". "Balok" suggests a block, so use "tanda menyerupai pita/palang".
Item 21: "putative groups" is translated "kelompok sementara". "Kelompok dugaan" or "kelompok yang diusulkan" is closer.

betta-siamorientalis.name: Cupang Siamorientalis
notes: Item 20: "kelompok dugaan" for "putative groups" is slightly stiff; "kelompok yang diduga/kelompok sementara" reads more naturally.
Item 12: "Di alam kemungkinan besar sebagian besar memakan" is repetitive and has no subject; try "Di alam, ikan ini kemungkinan besar terutama memakan ...".

betta-simorum.name: Betta simorum
notes: Item 3: 'Dasar perairannya ... karena air tidak selalu tersedia sepanjang tahun' — source says 'permanent water is not always available'; 'sepanjang tahun' is OK but 'nyaris nol' for 'negligible' is fine. Main issue is elsewhere.
Item 11: 'sirip punggung, sirip ekor, dan ekor jantan lebih runcing' — 'caudal and tail fin' is redundant in source, so the Indonesian repeats the error; merge as 'sirip ekor'. Minor.

Item 14: 'larva tetap berada di sarang' — the source says 'eggs ... remaining in the nest' until yolk sac absorbed; fine, but 'Jantan mungkin membangun sarang di dalam tabung atau selongsong' translates 'canister' poorly (use 'tabung film').
Item 14: 'sperma' for 'milt' should be 'cairan sperma/mani' (minor).

Item 14: 'cacing darah beku' vs 'burayak' used for fry; 'larva' for 'eggs' is inconsistent and misleading — should be 'telur' or 'larva yang baru menetas'. Source says 'eggs hatch ... remaining in the nest' meaning the hatchlings.
Item 14: 'Pasangan tidak perlu dipisah' fine; but 'sperma ... dilepaskan' ok.
Item 8: 'kutu air' for Daphnia is acceptable but 'Daphnia' is the usual hobby term; 'kutu air' is common in Indonesia, minor.
Item 7: 'blackworm' translated as 'cacing sutra' is incorrect: cacing sutra is Tubifex; blackworm is Lumbriculus, so the food type is changed. Use 'blackworm (Lumbriculus)' or 'cacing hitam'.
Item 4: 80 × 30 cm base, 72 L: volume depends on height; source given, fine.
Item 1: 'sarang busa' fine; 'Perkembangbiakan' OK.

betta-smaragdina.name: Betta Smaragdina
notes: Item 3: second sentence omitted: 'The fish offered are quality Betta smaragdina bred by a breeder in Vietnam.' Translate it, or drop it only if it is shop talk. Also 'habitat' became 'akuarium'.

Item 19: 'sampai telur betina habis' for 'until the female is spent' is acceptable, but 'burayak yang jatuh' should be 'telur yang jatuh'. The English says the male collects fallen eggs, and the eggs have not hatched yet. This changes the meaning.
Item 19: 'Burayak membutuhkan pakan seukuran infusoria' is fine, but 'sperma' for 'milt' should be 'cairan sperma/mani'. Minor.
Item 20: 'Genus Betta adalah genus dengan jumlah spesies terbanyak' is acceptable. 'tutup insang sejajar' for 'opercles parallel' is fine. Minor.
Item 9: 'Kayu (driftwood)' should read 'kayu apung/bangkai kayu (driftwood)', or use 'akar/kayu rambatan'. Minor.
Item 16: 'kurang hias' is awkward; use 'kurang indah/kurang berumbai' for 'less ornate'. Minor.
Item 4: 'anggota kelompok splendens lainnya' for 'other splendens' is slightly altered. Minor.

betta-splendens.name: Ikan cupang
notes: Item 18: "Tubifex" translated as "Cacing sutra" is acceptable, but "Brine shrimp" -> "Artemia" fine; real issue: "Glassworms" rendered "jentik Chaoborus" adds a fact/specific genus not in source; keep just "glassworm" or "jentik kaca".

Item 22: "Species with body shapes or trailing finnage" -> "Spesies dengan bentuk tubuh serupa" adds "serupa" and drops the sense that similar body shapes/long fins should be avoided; clarify as "bentuk tubuh serupa atau sirip panjang menjuntai".

Item 21: "tiger barbs" -> "ikan sumatra (tiger barb)" is OK, but the sentence "Betta fish recognize their owners" is fine; no change. Real issue: item 11 "low-maintenance" -> "tidak merepotkan perawatannya" is awkward; use "mudah dirawat".

Item 27: "Artemia nauplii... excessive amounts of the latter" ok, but "the adults do not usually eat their offspring" while item 26 says male may eat young; source conflict, fine. Item 27: "Proses ini diulang sampai telur betina habis" is fine.
Item 26: "A hiding place... " fine; "36 jam berikutnya" ok. Item 5: "should be discouraged" -> "sebaiknya tidak didukung" weakens meaning; use "sebaiknya tidak dilestarikan/dicegah".
Item 14: "power filters ... not suitable" -> "filter bertenaga pompa yang kuat" adds "yang kuat" and odd wording; use "filter eksternal/power filter".
Item 15: "tidak rewel dengan kisaran 6,0–8,0 yang masih bisa diterima" is awkward; rephrase "tidak rewel, kisaran pH 6,0–8,0 masih dapat diterima".

Item 4: "we pick" rendered as "dipilihkan oleh penjual", and the original shop talk adapted; the sentence "Semua jantan berasal dari garis keturunan yang sama" fine. Item 29: "two to three inches (5–7 cm)" ok.
Item 12: "Keep the aquarium well-covered ... an excellent jumper" -> "pelompat yang sangat andal" is unnatural; use "pelompat ulung".

boraras-brigittae.name: Rasbora Chili
notes: Item 10: GH/KH "°d" kept as-is, fine, but Temperature range of 22–28 °C is OK; no issue. Real problem is item 11: the EN gives Temperature 20–28°C, ID matches, fine; however item 10 and 11 conflict in source, not translation.

Item 2: "Mosquito rasbora" left in English as the common name; the source is fine, but "dijual dengan nama spesies ini" is wrong. The English says traded "under its name" (the common name), not "spesies". Use "dengan nama ini".

Item 21: "Di antara semuanya, Boraras ternyata membentuk kelompok monofiletik dengan Rasboroides" adds "Boraras" as the subject where the English says "Of these it was found to form...". Acceptable, but "Of these" is ambiguous. Keep neutral.

Item 21: "ikan bertulang sejati" for "bony fishes" is OK, but "Hasil untuk B. brigittae dan T. heteromorpha dinilai belum meyakinkan dalam beberapa hal" is fine. Real error: "Ikan ini kadang dijual dengan nama dagang lain" for "alternative vernacular names" — these are common names, not trade names; use "nama umum lain".
Item 1: "Rasbora chili" is described as "Mature males ... merah tua" for crimson-red; "crimson" is closer to "merah delima/merah terang" than "merah tua" (dark red). Minor.
Item 1/17: "garis gelap tegas di sepanjang sisi tubuhnya" is fine, but "Daftar Merah IUCN: Data Deficient (Kekurangan Data)" is fine. No change needed.
Item 14: "Seperti spesies Boraras lainnya... kemungkinan adalah mikropredator" is okay. "dengan pelet butiran" adds "pelet" for "granules"; minor.

Item 20: "Meskipun spesies ini jelas mau memakan telurnya" — "certainly will eat its eggs" is OK. "Alas plastik model 'rumput'" is fine. In "Airnya ... ber-pH 5,0–6,5, 1–5 dGH" the structure is awkward; rephrase.

boraras-maculatus.name: Dwarf Rasbora
notes: Item 10: "siklus nitrogennya belum matang" is a slight interpretive rendering of "biologically-immature"; "akuarium yang belum matang secara biologis" would be closer.
Item 20: "jaring dengan lubang yang cukup besar" is fine, but "segerombol Java moss" is a little awkward; "seikat/gumpalan Java moss" is more natural.

boraras-merah.name: Boraras merah
notes: Item 9: "kayu beech biasa atau kayu ek aman digunakan" — 'common beech' is mistranslated as an adjective; use "kayu beech (Fagus) atau ek" and keep the oak/beech wording clear.
Item 16: "pygmy Corydoras" left in English; use "Corydoras kerdil/pigmi".

Item 18: "lebih gemuk" and "warna yang lebih pudar" are acceptable, but "intense fiery red to orange" is rendered as "oranye yang pekat", which shifts the meaning slightly. Rephrase as "merah menyala pekat hingga oranye".

Item 21: "tidak menjaga anaknya" is fine, but "zero parental care" plus "Setelah pemijahan dimulai, pemijahan akan berlanjut setiap hari" is awkward. Rephrase as "pemijahan akan terus berlanjut setiap hari".
Item 22: the whole sentence is omitted. It is shop talk and a byline, so this is acceptable only if it was meant to be dropped; check it.
Item 14: "Daphnia" is rendered "kutu air (Daphnia)" in 14 but "kutu air (daphnia)" in 13; make the term consistent. "Kutu air" is a loose term.
Item 23: "kelompok danionin" for 'the other sub-group contains the danionins' is unclear; say "subkelompok lainnya berisi danionin".

botia-almorhae.name: Botia Yoyo
notes: Item 12: 'Hobiis di Inggris cenderung memakai Levamisole' leaves out 'the antibiotic' (antibiotik) from the source. Add it, or note the class of drug.
Item 12: 'mental lobe berkembang menjadi sungut' leaves an English anatomical term. Use 'cuping mental' or add the English in brackets.
Item 12: 'skinny disease', 'greying out', 'Shadowing' and 'loachy dance' are mixed in without consistent glosses. Give an Indonesian gloss for 'skinny disease' and 'Shadowing'.

botia-kubotai.name: Botia kubotai
notes: Item 11: 'seorang anggota komunitas' drops the named member 'SF member Mark Duffill'. That's acceptable as neutral wording, but it is slightly vague.
Item 12: 'Hobiis' is non-standard. Use 'penghobi' or 'hobiis akuarium'.
Item 9: 'butuh kontak rutin dengan sesama jenisnya' is fine, but 'penyendiri' for 'withdrawn' is a bit awkward. Use 'menarik diri' or 'pemalu'.
Item 6: 'botia punya rasa ingin tahu tinggi' switches between 'botiid' and 'botia' for the same group. Use one term.
Item 6: 'paling mudah beradaptasi di akuarium yang stabil' is clumsy. Say 'paling mudah beradaptasi di akuarium yang stabil dan matang'.
Item 2: 'Anakannya' for juveniles is slightly off. 'Ikan muda' or 'juvenil' is more usual.
Item 8: 'zukini' for courgette is acceptable, but 'labu siam' or 'zucchini' is more common.
Item 3: 'anak sungai Megathat' for 'Megathat stream' is slightly inaccurate, because 'anak sungai' means tributary. Use 'sungai kecil Megathat' or 'aliran Megathat'.

brachygobius-doriae.name: Bumblebee goby
notes: Item 11: "goby 'bumblebee'" – word order is slightly unnatural; "goby bumblebee" without quotes, or keep "bumblebee goby", would read more naturally.
Item 10: "dengan cara tertentu" for "somehow" is vague; "dengan cara apa pun" or "perlu diberi pemberat" would be cleaner.

brachygobius-mekongensis.name: Mekong Bumblebee Goby
notes: Item 2: 'between bridge at between bridge at Muang Kengkok' duplication in source was silently fixed; fine, but 'Provinsi Nongkhai ... Thailand timur laut' ok. No issue.
Item 5: 'jangan pernah dimasukkan ke akuarium baru yang belum matang (belum siklus nitrogen)' adds explanatory content; 'belum siklus nitrogen' is awkward, use 'belum tersiklus'.
Item 10: 'meskipun gambar ditetapkan pada profil' is awkward/unclear for 'we've assigned images to profiles'; rephrase e.g. 'foto dicocokkan dengan profil'.
Item 10: 'spesies lain pernah dijumpai dijual dengan label nama ini' is slightly awkward; the neutral phrasing should be 'spesies lain pernah ditemukan dijual dengan label nama ini'.
Item 3: 'temporal swamps' rendered as 'rawa musiman' is fine, but 'lahan basah yang masih alami' for 'undisturbed marshland' loses 'marsh'; use 'rawa yang belum terganggu'.
Item 10: 'tidak bersisik' for 'naked' opercle/nape fine, but 'kadang tanpa sisik' for opercle in B. nunus is fine; 'gurat sisi di kepala' should be 'sistem garis rusuk (gurat sisi) kepala' - minor.
Item 9: 'betina yang sedang mengandung telur' acceptable; 'burayak' OK. No issue.
Item 8: 'agresi tersebar ke beberapa individu' is stiff; use 'agresi terbagi ke banyak ikan'.

brachygobius-sabanus.name: Bumblebee Goby
notes: "Kalimantan bagian timur laut" (items 1 and 2) for Sabah is geographically wrong. Kalimantan is only the Indonesian part of Borneo, and Sabah is in Malaysia. Use "Pulau Kalimantan (Borneo) bagian timur laut" or "Borneo bagian timur laut".
Item 10: "supaya tidak mengapung" adds a reason that the source doesn't give ("weighed down somehow"). Say only "perlu diberi pemberat".

brachygobius-xanthomelas.name: Bumblebee goby
notes: "Dengan jumlah segitu" is too colloquial for a handbook; use "Dengan jumlah sebanyak itu".
"foto online" could be the more standard "foto di internet" or "foto daring".

brachygobius-xanthozonus.name: Bumblebee goby
notes: "selalu ternyata B. doriae atau B. sabanus" (items 1 and 4) is awkward word order. Use "ternyata selalu B. doriae atau B. sabanus" or "selalu berupa B. doriae atau B. sabanus".
"bumblebee goby" is left in English in items 1 and 4. This is acceptable as a trade name, but you could add an Indonesian gloss such as "ikan gobi lebah" on first mention.
"Max size ... (1.5 in SL)" was dropped in item 1. This is fine, since 38 mm is the metric value.

breitensteinia-cessator.name: Breitensteinia cessator
notes: "punggung adiposa yang rendah dan panjang" for "long low adipose ridge": "punggung" reads as the back, not a ridge. Use "lunas/rigi adiposa" or "lipatan lemak yang rendah dan panjang".
"Belum ada laporan. Tidak ada laporan pemijahan." is repetitive. It is faithful to the source, but could be smoothed to "Belum ada laporan pemijahan."

brevibora-cheeya.name: Brevibora cheeya
notes: Item 4: "about 72 litres" is kept, but the English gives the volume as only a rough figure alongside the dimensions. 80 × 30 cm with no height stated cannot give 72 L. This is a source issue, so mention it only if the translator was meant to flag it.

Item 8: "does not compete well with much larger or more boisterous species" is translated as "lebih agresif" (more aggressive). "Boisterous" means rowdy or lively, not aggressive, so use "lebih lincah/heboh".
Item 11: "Several years prior to its description" is rendered as if the species were the one described. Fine. But "lokasi yang samar" for "vague locality" is awkward; use "lokasi yang tidak jelas".
Item 5: "common beech or oak" is left as "beech atau oak" with no explanation. Add the local context, e.g. "kayu beech (Fagus) atau oak (ek)", or advise on locally available hardwoods.
Item 5: "Cryptocoryne spp. semuanya mampu bertahan" has a broken sentence structure. Change it to "tanaman seperti Microsorum, Taxiphyllum, dan Cryptocoryne spp. semuanya mampu bertahan".
Item 11: "larger head and prepectoral length" is rendered "kepala dan panjang prepektoral lebih besar". Use "kepala lebih panjang dan panjang prepektoral lebih besar".
Item 8: "kalah bersaing dengan spesies" is fine. However, "temannya setangki lainnya dibiarkan" is awkward; use "tidak mengganggu penghuni lain".

camposcia-retusa.name: Kepiting Dekorator
notes: Item 2: the English says the crabs "may simply miss the food you give them". The Indonesian "pakan yang Anda berikan terlewat oleh mereka" is acceptable, but "Karena mereka tidak banyak bergerak" for "not very mobile" is fine too. The wording "kurang cocok" is okay.

Item 12: "larvae normally hatch overnight, occasionally in the early morning" became "menjelang pagi", which is acceptable. However, "Waktu mencapai dewasa" for "Maturity" is fine. "Uneaten food was removed" is fine.
Item 13: the English "Superfamily: Majidae" is given as "Superfamili: Majidae". Majidae is a family, but this mirrors the source, so keep it. "Subfilum: Crustacea" mirrors the source too.
Item 13: "Rostrum: the head is broad, slightly deflexed anteriorly, with an emarginated anterior edge". "bertakik" for "emarginated" is loose but acceptable.
Item 8: "seagrass leaves" became "helaian daun lamun", which is fine. "Decor should replicate" is fine.
Item 10: "Social: no" became "Hidup berkelompok: tidak". This is acceptable.
Item 12: the Indonesian keeps the awkward "Kelangsungan hidup zoea ... pada salinitas 35 dan 38" (as in the source). It also keeps "NH4+/NH3 dan NO2", which is fine.
Item 3: "Cape Grenville dan Port Denison" are left untranslated. Consider "Tanjung Grenville", but this is a minor point.

carassius-auratus.name: Ikan mas koki
notes: Item 1: "Varian ikan mas koki" drops "We received ... from China" nuance; also "koki" and "mas koki" are used inconsistently for goldfish. Minor.
Item 4: translation is left out entirely (the stocklist code 808202 and the wholesale-only note). This is shop talk, so dropping it is allowed.
Item 7: "koki komet asli berasal dari ikan Crucian carp" – the Crucian carp should have an Indonesian name or at least be explained (ikan mas karper/Crucian carp). "tidak ada di alam" is acceptable.
Item 11: "Salinitas: tetap tumbuh baik hingga 6‰" – "good growth up to 6‰" is rendered loosely. "Tahan suhu tinggi" is fine.
Item 14: "pemakan dasar" is fine, but "kutu air (moina)" is acceptable. "Feeding every day should be roughly 2%" is ok. No serious errors.

Item 17: "Zebrafish" is rendered "Ikan zebra", yet the text says "zebra danio"; use "zebra danio" consistently. "Mas koki bertubuh panjang ... mereka bisa lebih cepat" is slightly vague (outpace in swimming).
Item 20: "Betina sebagian besar matang kelamin pada tahun ke-2" is awkward; use "umumnya matang pada tahun kedua".
Item 3: "Bertelur" for "Egg layer" is fine; "Top and mid-dweller" is OK.

Item 13: "Gunakan kerikil halus dan membulat" – English says "smooth, rounded", but "halus" may be read as fine-grained, which conflicts with "large enough not to be swallowed". Use "licin" or "mulus".
Item 15: "gigi geraham" for goldfish pharyngeal molars is imprecise; "gigi faring" is more accurate. Also "mas koki" and "koki" used inconsistently.

caridina-multidentata.name: Udang Amano
notes: Item 8: "feromon pemijahan" for "breeding hormone" – the source says hormone; "feromon" is a technically different term, so use "hormon pemijahan" or keep the source wording.
Item 9: "Saat gelisah atau tegang" for "When excited" – adds a nuance; the source has a slightly different meaning (excited/stressed). Consider "saat terstimulasi/stres".
Item 9: "membongkar kiriman udang" – "unpack the animals" is better as "membuka kemasan udang"; "membongkar kiriman" is awkward.

Item 6: "Garis di punggung itu bisa memiliki garis putih polos" is repetitive/awkward; also "ikan penghuni akuarium yang sama" for "tankmates" is clumsy, use "penghuni akuarium lainnya" or "teman satu akuarium".
Item 6: "tembus pandang, berwarna cokelat atau cokelat muda" – "tan" is better as "cokelat keabu-abuan/krem"; and "Udang kecil yang renyah tidak boleh menjadi santapan" is a bit stiff.
Item 1: "Umur" for "Life expectancy" should be "Harapan hidup" or "Usia hidup"; the bracketed imperial conversions were dropped, which is acceptable.
Item 4: "Hanya karena udang amano suka membersihkan akuarium" loses "for a living" and the rendering is stiff; "kualitas kimia air" is an odd rendering of "water chemistry" (use "parameter air").

Item 3: "Aslinya hidup di rawa air tawar, krustasea ini baru belakangan masuk" – ungrammatical subject structure; fix to "Aslinya hidup di rawa air tawar, krustasea ini baru-baru ini diperkenalkan ke hobi akuarium".

carinotetraodon-travancoricus.name: Pea puffer
notes: #24: both daphnia and moina are rendered "kutu air", so the two cannot be told apart. Use "kutu air (daphnia)" and "moina", or "kutu air" and "kutu air moina".
#32: "yang membatasi bintik-bintik kuning keemasan" is imprecise for "which mark the shining golden yellow spots". Better: "yang menandai" or "di sekitar bintik...".
#29: "Pea puffer bisa cukup jorok" is colloquial for "messy". "banyak menghasilkan kotoran" is more natural.

channa-andrao.name: Channa Andrao
notes: "terkenal jago kabur" is too colloquial for a handbook; use "terkenal pandai meloloskan diri".
"ikan pakan hidup seperti ikan beranak": "feeder fish" would read more clearly as "ikan umpan/ikan pakan"; "hidup" is not in the source.
"tidak dapat dicerna dengan baik" for "cannot be properly metabolised": "dimetabolisme" is closer.

channa-asiatica.name: Channa asiatica
notes: Item 8: "Atau, seperti yang umumnya diduga saat ini, merupakan kompleks spesies..." is a sentence fragment. Join it to the previous sentence, e.g. "...banyak varian, atau, seperti yang umumnya diduga saat ini, kompleks spesies...".
Item 8: "peternak" for breeders is slightly off for fish. "pembudidaya" or "breeder" is more usual among hobbyists.
Item 4: "Parameter air tidak berpengaruh" is a bit loose for "irrelevant". "tidak penting" or "tidak menjadi masalah" would be more natural.

channa-aurantimaculata.name: Channa Auranti
notes: Item 4: "tidak segeneralis banyak spesies Channa lain secara ekologis" is stiff. Something like "kurang bersifat generalis secara ekologis dibanding banyak spesies Channa lain" would read more naturally.
Item 8: "Predator sejati" for "obligate predator" is understandable but not the usual term. "Karnivora obligat" or "pemangsa murni" would be clearer.

channa-bleheri.name: Channa Bleheri
notes: Item 8: "jantung sapi atau ayam" could be read as chicken heart; say "daging ayam" or "daging sapi (jantung) atau daging ayam".
Item 10: "saat sedang bertelur" for "gravid" is imprecise; "saat sedang bunting telur" or "saat membawa telur" is better.

Item 12: Several terms are left in English, such as "isthmus", "hypurapophysis", "urostyle", "epibranchial" and "branchial". Add Indonesian forms (e.g. "tulang epibrankial", "pelat gigi brankial") or put them in italics.

channa-stewartii.name: Channa Stewartii
notes: "Selain ikan hidup maupun ikan mati": awkward; better "Selain ikan hidup maupun mati" or "ikan hidup dan ikan mati".", ""mau makan pelet stik": source says "sticks" (food sticks); "pelet stik" is fine but "pelet" is an added specificity, consider "stik pakan".", ""Channa ini" in sentence 1: "This snakehead" is better rendered as "Ikan bandotan/gabus" or "Snakehead ini"; "Channa ini" is slightly vague but acceptable.", ""Karena habitat aslinya tidak berada di wilayah tropis": fine meaning, but "tidak berada di wilayah tropis" could be more natural as "bukan di daerah tropis".", ""pengeram mulut": common hobby term is "mouthbrooder" or "pengeram telur di mulut"; consider "ikan pengerami mulut".

chitala-blanci.name: Royal Knifefish
notes: Item 4: 'Mekong hulu, Kamboja utara' is fine, but item 3 is not: the English lists 'Thailand, Laos, and Cambodia' and the ID matches, so no change needed there. The real problem is in item 5: 'perairan berarus kuat' is fine.

Item 12: 'Terhadap sesama jenis dan teman satu akuarium yang tidak bisa dimangsa, ikan belida sangat damai' is acceptable, but 'Chitala' is translated inconsistently as 'ikan belida' here and elsewhere. Use 'belida' consistently, and give the common name 'Asian featherback' where it is used.
Item 1: 'sirip punggung berkembang baik' is stiff; use 'sirip punggung yang berkembang baik'.
Item 8: 'kayu rendam' for driftwood is non-standard; use 'kayu apung' or 'driftwood'. 'aliran/sirkulasi' should be one term.
Item 11: 'ikan mas koki kecil' is fine, but 'kebanyakan bisa beradaptasi dengan baik dengan pakan mati' reads awkwardly (double 'dengan'). Rephrase it.
Item 11: 'predator sejati' for 'obligate predator' is acceptable, but 'obligate' means it must feed on animal prey. Consider 'predator obligat'.
Item 18: the 'Text & photos' byline is dropped, which is correct. No fix needed.
Item 16: 'memijah di atas batu' is OK. 'Pada musim kawin' should be 'musim pemijahan' for fish.

chitala-ornata.name: Clown Knife
notes: Item 7: "ikan mas koki kecil" - 'small goldfish' as feeder; 'ikan mas koki' is redundant/awkward, use "ikan mas koki" or "koki kecil" consistently.
Item 7: "ikan umpan hidup" for 'feeder fish' is loose; prefer "ikan pakan (feeder)".
Items 1/11: "leucistic" left in English; use "leusistik" or add a local term.
Items 1/11: "dikembangkan lewat penangkaran selektif khusus untuk pasar ini" - 'line-bred for the purpose' is slightly over-interpreted; use "dikembangbiakkan secara line-breeding untuk tujuan itu".
Item 11: "populer tanpa alasan yang jelas" - 'inexplicably' fine, but "sirip anal ... menyatu dengan sirip ekor" OK; "Notopterid" could be glossed as "ikan famili Notopteridae".
Item 7: "Predator sejati" for 'obligate predator' is acceptable but "predator obligat" is more precise; sentence "mau menerima ... juga pelet kering" is slightly clumsy.
Item 6: Fahrenheit dropped, which is fine; no issue.
Item 5: "kayu apung (driftwood)" - hobbyists say "kayu driftwood" or "bogwood"; "kayu apung" means floating wood and may mislead.

chromobotia-macracanthus.name: Botia
notes: Item 1: "Ovipar/memijah" for "Spawners" is slightly awkward; "Pemijah telur" or "Ovipar" alone would read more naturally.
Item 3: "beberapa sentimeter" is vague for "a few inches"; a rounded figure such as "sekitar 5–8 cm" would be clearer.

clarias-batrachus.name: Lele kampung
notes: Items 2 and 12: "leucistic" is left in English. Give an Indonesian term or gloss, for example "leusistik (albino parsial)".
Items 2 and 6: "jago sekali kabur" is too colloquial for a handbook. Use something like "pandai meloloskan diri".
Item 3: "Yang sudah pasti, ikan ini hanya diketahui dari..." is awkward. Use "Hanya diketahui dengan pasti dari daerah aliran sungai di Jawa".
Item 2: "sangat predator" is a little unnatural. Use "sangat bersifat predator" or "pemangsa yang ganas".

corydoras-aeneus.name: Corydoras bronze
notes: "Corydoras bronze" / "cory": the common Indonesian hobby name is "corydoras perunggu" or "Bronze Corydoras"; consider keeping it consistent.
"Ikan ini dapat bernapas langsung dari udara (fakultatif)": "fakultatif" in brackets reads awkwardly; better "mampu bernapas dari udara secara fakultatif".
"keping tulang (armoured catfish)" and later "lele berlapis baja"/"berzirah": keep the wording consistent for armoured catfish.
"burayak" is correct but "benih" or "anakan" is more common among hobbyists.
"peternak" for breeders: "pembudidaya" or "breeder" is more natural for fish.
"perkawinan sekerabat terseleksi" for line-bred is clumsy; "pembiakan garis keturunan (line breeding)" would be clearer.
"Ikan ini sangat langka" and "hanya tersedia dalam jumlah terbatas" are fine, but "Gold Shoulder" is left in English without explanation; this is acceptable.

corydoras-paleatus.name: Corydoras Paleatus
notes: Item 2: "Imports of this species did not appear for more than 10 years" is rendered "tidak pernah diimpor" (never imported). Use "tidak muncul/tidak ada impor" so the sense of a period without imports stays.
Item 6: "morsels of food" is rendered "sisa makanan" (leftovers). Use "serpihan/remah makanan", because the fish look for food, not scraps.
Item 11: "peternak" (livestock farmer) for breeders is non-standard. Use "pembudidaya" or "penghobi".
Item 1, 4: "kolam-kolam alami" adds "alami" (natural), which is not in the source "pools". Use "kolam" or "genangan".
Item 13: "menyerap oksigen melalui ususnya" and "menyambar udara" are a little loose. Use "menelan/menghirup udara" for "gulp of air".
Item 9: "Lele" for catfish is acceptable, but "cichlid kerdil" is awkward. Use "cichlid dwarf/cichlid kerdil (dwarf cichlid)" or "cichlid kecil".
Item 11: "Kelompok indukan" and "burayak" are fine, but "Corydoras tidak secenderung beberapa ikan lain" is clumsy. Use "Corydoras tidak sesering sebagian ikan lain memakan telurnya".
Item 12: "varian hasil budidaya" for "breeding forms" is fine, but "Ikan veteran" is a literal rendering. Use "ikan lawas/klasik" for naturalness.

corydoras-panda.name: Corydoras panda
notes: Item 10: "half-grown animals" translated as "Ikan yang masih setengah dewasa ini" is okay, but "swarm behaviour" -> "perilaku bergerombol" fine; no fix needed except the kind of fish refers to juveniles: use "ikan remaja" (minor).

Item 13: "burayak tidak akan tersedot" fine, but "2 jantan untuk setiap betina" OK; "Udang cherry ... cukup efektif" for "work well" fine. However "Menyaring air melalui gambut ... akan membantu" fine. Wording "meski bisa sampai 4 butir yang dikeluarkan" is awkward; use "meski kadang sampai 4 butir sekaligus".

Item 13: "Musim ini terjadi bersamaan dengan musim dingin di Inggris" keeps UK reference, acceptable but for Indonesian readers clarify (e.g., 'musim dingin di belahan bumi utara'); also 'Dapat ... akuarium berdasar kosong' fine.

Item 14: "Ini adalah sistem penomoran yang sangat sederhana" fine; "Namun, asalkan ruangnya cukup, hal ini jarang sampai menimbulkan luka fisik" OK. "penghirup udara fakultatif" is stiff; prefer "mampu bernapas dengan udara bebas bila perlu".
Item 14: "pemakan sisa" for scavengers; "agresi ... nyaris tidak pernah terdengar" is stiff; prefer "hampir tidak pernah terjadi".
Item 9: "kutu air" for Daphnia is acceptable colloquial but "Daphnia" (kutu air) is clearer; "mikroworm" in item 13 should be "cacing mikro" or "microworm" in italics.
Item 2/5: "sungai kecil" for streams fine; "blackwater" left untranslated, consider "air hitam (blackwater)".

corydoras-pygmaeus.name: Corydoras pygmy
notes: Item 7: "Gurami coklat/licorice gourami" is wrong/invented; Parosphromenus is not a 'brown gourami'. Use "licorice gourami (Parosphromenus)" only.
Item 7: "kalah bersaing dengannya saat makan" adds "saat makan" (while feeding), which the source does not say; the original says only outcompete. Remove.
Item 5: "bahan botani (daun kering, ranting, dan sejenisnya)" adds a gloss not in the source; botanicals is a common hobby term, so keep "botanical" without the added list.
Item 3: "Persebarannya luas, tetapi di sebagian wilayah sebarannya rentan" is repetitive; say "Tersebar luas, tetapi rentan terhadap kerusakan habitat di sebagian wilayah sebarannya".
Item 1: "Belum Dievaluasi (Not Evaluated)" is acceptable but the English in brackets is unnecessary.
Item 9: "hasil penangkaran" is fine, but "These ... are captive-bred" (the specific stock being sold) is turned into a general statement; this loses the sense that the fish on offer are captive-bred.
Item 6: "mendukung ... keaktifan ikan" is ok, but "Termasuk pemakan hewan renik" for "Micro-carnivores" is loose; "mikrokarnivora" alone is closer.

corydoras-sterbai.name: Corydoras sterbai
notes: Item 13: "2 jantan untuk setiap betina" is fine, but "selalu lebih baik jumlah jantan lebih banyak" is awkward. Rephrase as "rasio jantan terhadap betina sebaiknya lebih tinggi".
Item 13: "burayak" is used for both eggs hatched and young ("anakan" and "burayak" are mixed). Use one consistent term, preferably "burayak" or "anakan".

Item 13: "Musim ini bertepatan dengan musim dingin di Inggris" is a locale-specific fact kept as is. For Indonesian readers, add a note such as "musim dingin belahan bumi utara (Inggris)", or say that the wet season falls in the northern winter.
Item 14: "Walaupun mereka akan memakan apa pun yang muat di mulut" is an overstatement of "bite-sized items such as eggs or fry". Say "hal-hal berukuran seukuran gigitan seperti telur atau burayak".

Item 14: "pakan yang lolos dari ikan-ikan di atasnya" and "hanya diharapkan bertahan dari sisa pakan" are stiff. Rephrase as "jika hanya mengandalkan sisa pakan yang lolos dari ikan lain di lapisan atas".
Item 14: "Kedua sistem ini diterapkan oleh" should read "diperkenalkan oleh". The word "Loricariidae" is fine.
Item 1: "toko ikan hias" is fine, but "diternakkan" and "hasil penangkaran" are inconsistent for a farmed or bred fish. Use one term consistently.
Item 8: "cabang kayu apung (driftwood) (kalau ..." has a double parenthesis, which is awkward and hard to read. Restructure it.
Item 6: "kali" for creeks is informal. Use "anak sungai kecil, sungai kecil/parit".
Item 10: "kutu air" for Daphnia is a loose term. Use "daphnia" or "kutu air (Daphnia)".

crossocheilus-burmanicus.name: Crossocheilus burmanicus
notes: Item 4: Volume '304 liter' is wrong conversion of 80 US gal (≈ 303 L); use 'sekitar 300 liter' — more importantly check rounding; minor.

Items 1, 3: 'krikil halus' is an invented/odd term for 'gravel' since 'kerikil' already used for pebbles; use 'kerikil' for pebbles and 'kerikil halus/koral' consistently, or 'kerikil' and 'kerikil kecil'.
Item 1: 'sambil merumput biofilm' and 'dirumput' — 'merumput' is awkward for fish; use 'memakan/mengerik biofilm'.
Item 6: 'aufwuchs' left untranslated without explanation; add 'aufwuchs (lapisan alga dan mikroorganisme pada permukaan)'.
Item 6: 'blanched courgette' → 'zukini yang direbus sebentar' fine, but 'Kacang polong yang sudah dikupas' for 'shelled peas' is OK; 'betah' is colloquial for 'settled in' — use 'sudah beradaptasi'.
Item 7: 'Sampai saat ini diagnosis ... belum bisa didapatkan' drops the 'We've been unable' subject nuance; rephrase as 'Belum diperoleh diagnosis...'.
Item 7: 'jari-jari bercabang' ok; 'lobus rostral' could be 'lobus rostral (rostral lobes)' for clarity.
Item 8: Reference list left untranslated, acceptable; no change needed.

ctenolucius-hujeta.name: Hujeta
notes: Item 2/9: "Ternyata" for "Surprisingly" reads as a discovery, not as a surprise; "Anehnya" or "Mengejutkannya" would be closer.
Item 2/9: "mencari makan di dasar" is fine, but "teman setangkinya" is slightly stiff; "penghuni akuarium lain" is more natural.

cyclocheilichthys-janthochir.name: Temperas
notes: Item 1: "Di toko ikan" for "fishhouse" is acceptable, but "shark" should be "hiu"/"sepat" style; better: sebut "(shark)" with local term e.g. "hiu". Minor.
Item 1: "tidak ribet dalam hal lain" is colloquial; use "tidak rewel dalam hal lain".
Item 8: "biologically immature aquarium" is rendered "siklus nitrogennya belum matang"; it is acceptable but add "akuarium yang belum matang secara biologis" for fidelity. Minor.
Item 8: "agar tumbuh sehat" for "to thrive" OK; but "jangan pernah dimasukkan" switches from descriptive to imperative; use "tidak boleh dimasukkan".
Item 15: "Spesimen yang tersedia saat ini" drops "at the fishhouse" (shop talk, allowed); "Setiap pertambahan panjang 1 cm" is ok.
Item 12: "tidak mudah stres" for "less nervous" is slightly off; use "tidak mudah gugup/takut".
Item 11: "Enrichment" rendered as "nilai tambah" loses meaning slightly; use "pengayaan/pemanis" or "tambahan yang menarik". Minor.
Item 4: type locality 'Kapuas River in Pontianak' left in English inside translated phrase; use "Sungai Kapuas di Pontianak" or keep entire quote consistent.
Item 10: "kutu air" for Daphnia is acceptable; "Penghobi ... mendapati" fine. Item 13: "kurang berwarna" is awkward; use "warnanya sedikit lebih pudar".

cyphotilapia-frontosa.name: Frontosa
notes: "berjenong" / "jenong": the usual hobby term is "nonjol" (Frontosa berjidat nonjol/kepala benjol). "jenong" is a Louhan term and is awkward here. Consider "benjolan di dahi".
"tampak unik" for "look bizarre": "bizarre" means odd or strange. Use "tampak aneh/mencolok" instead.
"Hasil penangkaran enam garis dari Taiwan": this is missing a noun. Write "Ikan hasil penangkaran bergaris enam dari Taiwan".
