"banteng" in quotes for "bulls among the cichlids": the idiom is unclear. Consider "tergolong cichlid bertubuh besar dan kekar".
"pengeram mulut (mouthbrooder)": hobbyists usually say "mouthbrooder" or "pengerem mulut". This is fine but not ideal. "Pemijahannya" is also fine.

cyrtocara-moorii.name: Blue Dolphin
notes: Item 10: "spitting out the brood early" was translated as "memuntahkan telur atau burayaknya lebih awal". This adds "telur atau" (eggs or), which the source doesn't say. Use "memuntahkan erami lebih awal" or just "burayak".

Item 10: "Sebagian peternak mengeluarkan burayak ... pada umur 2 minggu" says the fry are stripped at 2 weeks. The source says "at the 2 week stage" of brooding. Say "pada minggu ke-2 pengeraman" so it isn't read as the fry's age.
Item 10: "Selama masa ini betina tidak makan" is fine, but "warna mengeram berupa pola gelap" is awkward. Use "warna khas induk mengerami dengan pola gelap".
Item 10: "Ikan ini adalah mouthbrooder induk betina (betina mengerami telur di mulut) yang poligami" is clumsy. Use "mouthbrooder maternal poligami (betina mengerami telur di dalam mulut)".

Item 8: "Damai dan sebaiknya tidak dipelihara bersama spesies yang agresif ... tetapi ... akan mengintimidasi" is a muddled sentence. "Boisterous" is better as "hiperaktif/kasar" than "agresif" (items 1 and 8). "spesies Synodontis dari danau Rift" should be "Danau-danau Rift" and capitalised.
Item 8: "Teman satu akuarium" is OK, but "tankmates" is more naturally "penghuni bersama" or "tankmate" as hobbyists say it.
Item 4: The US gallon figure was dropped and the bracket removed. This is acceptable, but the volume is reported as "sekitar 257 liter" with false precision. Round to about 260 L.
Item 9: "jenong (nuchal hump)" is fine, but "Sulit dibedakan jenis kelaminnya" could use "sulit disexing" as hobbyists say it. This is minor.

danio-albolineatus.name: Pearl danio
notes: Item 7: the English says the fish tolerate colder temperatures; 'Pearl danio cukup tahan suhu yang lebih dingin' is fine, but 'paling bagus di air netral' is awkward. Rephrase as 'tumbuh paling baik di air netral'.

Item 11: 'Masukkan betina ... jumlahnya setengah dari jumlah jantan' says females are half the number of males. The English says the same, but the order is confusing. Rephrase to make clear it is half as many females as males.
Item 6: 'Warna mengilapnya' for 'iridescent colours' is weak. Use 'warna irisdesen/berkilau pelangi'.
Item 2: 'Spesies yang santai ini' and 'sangat pas untuk pemula' are colloquial. Use 'berwatak santai' and 'sangat cocok untuk pemula'.
Item 1: 'Sifat' for 'Social' and 'Harapan hidup' for 'Life expectancy' are acceptable, but 'Usia hidup' or 'Umur' is more common among hobbyists.
Item 11: 'Burayak' and 'Anakan' are both used for 'fry'. Pick one term, e.g. 'burayak', for consistency.
Item 11: 'pasangan pemijahnya sangat setia' is fine, but 'Kelereng sangat bagus dijadikan substrat' is awkward. Rephrase.

danio-choprae.name: Glowlight Danio
notes: Item 11: 'best removed after a couple of days' is translated 'setelah beberapa hari' – 'a couple of days' is ~2 days; use 'setelah sekitar dua hari'.
Item 11: 'the young free-swimming a couple of days later' is translated 'beberapa hari kemudian'; use 'dua hari kemudian'.
Item 11: 'half-filled with water' is fine, but 'The pair should spawn the following morning' is stated as 'biasanya memijah' – the hedge 'biasanya' was added; use 'seharusnya memijah'.

Item 11: 'The widely available plastic grass-type matting ... works very well' – 'hasilnya sangat baik' is acceptable, but 'power filter' as 'filter kecil bertenaga listrik' is unclear; use 'filter bertenaga (power filter)' or 'filter eksternal/hang-on kecil'.
Item 12: 'Spesies yang dulunya D. erythromicron...' is ungrammatical; use 'Spesies yang dahulu bernama D. erythromicron, ... dikelompokkan...'.
Item 12: 'ejaan alaminya adalah Choprae' – 'natural spelling' is better rendered 'ejaan yang wajar/semestinya'.
Item 12: 'Tinca tinca (ikan tench)' – use the Indonesian/trade name 'ikan tench (Tinca tinca)', or keep 'tench' without 'ikan'.
Item 2/6: 'Butuh tutup akuarium yang rapat' is informal; use 'Memerlukan penutup akuarium yang rapat'.
Item 6: 'batu besar yang halus terkikis air' is awkward; use 'batu besar yang halus karena terkikis arus'.
Item 12: 'goresan hitam' for 'black streak' – use 'garis hitam'.

danio-kyathit.name: Danio kyathit
notes: Item 12: "sirip anus" is used for the anal fin. "sirip dubur" is the more usual term in Indonesian ichthyology and hobby writing.
Item 11: "pada sore hari" for "in the evening". "malam hari" or "menjelang malam" would be closer for a water-change trigger.

danio-margaritatus.name: Rasbora Galaxy
notes: Item 18: 'termini aturisasi' is a broken word (stray space); should be 'termi­niaturisasi' / 'yang mengalami miniaturisasi'.

Item 18: 'Conway et al. (2008) memvalidasi ulang spesies ini' – revalidated the genus/species placement; fine, but 'two or more P stripes on the caudal' became 'dua atau lebih garis P di sirip ekor' ok. However 'pelvic and anal fins' -> 'sirip perut dan sirip anal' OK.
Item 18: 'tidak sedang terancam langsung oleh penangkapan berlebihan' is awkward; use 'tidak terancam langsung oleh penangkapan berlebihan'.
Item 18: 'Spesies yang dulunya D. erythromicron...' is ungrammatical; use 'Spesies yang dulu dikenal sebagai D. erythromicron...'.

Item 18: Kottelat 'revalidated Celestichthys' translated 'memvalidasi ulang' ok, but 'Kottelat hanya menyisakan ... di Danio, yang dipisahkan' is ambiguous; clarify that D. dangila was separated by size and tail shape.
Item 14: 'sparring' translated as 'saling bertarung' overstates; use 'saling bersaing/beradu gertak'. Also 'combative' in item 7 as 'agresif' fine.
Item 8: 'setup' left in English and 'oak' as 'ek'; use 'tata letak/aquascape' and 'daun oak'. 'kayu (driftwood)' fine.
Item 1: the 'Cyprinidae' and 'rasbora galaxy' fine; 'Galaxy Rasbora' is a trade name – ok.
Item 2: 'cyprinid mini' and 'paling heboh' are colloquial; use 'ikan sirip-cyprinid mini' / 'paling digembar-gemborkan'.
Item 6: ''rosy' loach' left untranslated and 'Microrasbora cf. rubescens' lost 'a' – acceptable; but 'Sympatric' rendered fine.

danio-rerio.name: Ikan Zebra
notes: Item 34: the Indonesian ends mid-sentence ('Artinya, tidak semua anggotan'). The rest of the English is missing: the Devario/Danio split, Mayden/Fang/Kottelat 2013, Celestichthys, the 89 mm (3.5 in) SL note, Brachydanio, and the Kullander 2015 / Catalog of Fishes / FishBase conclusion. Translate it in full.
Item 34: 'anggotan' is a typo for 'anggotanya', and the sentence needs completing with 'berasal dari satu nenek moyang yang sama'.
Items 1, 5, 8, 10: 'kubangan' for 'pools' means a muddy wallow. Use 'genangan' or 'kolam alami' for natural pools.

Item 27: the 'cross-reared' sentence ('dibesarkan bersama strain atau corak yang berbeda dari dirinya akan lebih menyukai corak tersebut') is muddled. It should say that fish reared with another strain prefer the pattern they were raised with.

datnioides-microlepis.name: Indo Datnoid
notes: Item 11: "mungkin sudah punah di Thailand" – "extirpated" means locally extinct; use "punah secara lokal di Thailand" or "hilang dari alam di Thailand".
Item 8: "tertekan" for "intimidated" could be "terintimidasi" or "terdesak" to be closer to the source.

datnioides-pulcher.name: Siamese Tiger Fish
notes: Item 5: "meskipun pola ini juga muncul pada malam hari" is slightly ambiguous. Make clear that this stress-like pattern is also the normal nighttime pattern, e.g. "pola yang sama juga ditampilkan pada malam hari".
Item 11: "famili tripletail laut Lobotidae" leaves "tripletail" in English. Add a local term such as "ikan tripletail (Lobotes)" or a short gloss.

desmopuntius-hexazona.name: Pentazona
notes: Item 4: English says the former locality ('Tuluk') is now Teluk Meranti, and that peat swamp forest was cleared 'to make space for oil palm plantations'. The Indonesian is fine on that. Still, 'Lokasi tipenya ... Tuluk dan Gunung Sahilan' is slightly altered: the original says 'of which the former is now known as'. This is a minor point.

Item 13: 'Hindari teman setangki yang ribut atau sangat agresif saat makan' adds 'saat makan'. The English says 'boisterous or very vigorous', not 'aggressive'. 'agresif' changes the meaning, so use 'sangat aktif/lincah'. 'bisa kalah bersaing dalam berebut pakan' is also redundant.

Item 17: 'D. pentazona ... terbatas di Kalimantan bagian barat laut, dan mungkin negara bagian Sarawak' is OK. But 'kelompok "tempat sampah" polifiletik' for 'catch-all' is a loose rendering; use 'wadah serba ada' or 'kelompok campuran'.

Item 17: 'pita ke-3 di pangkal awal sirip punggung' and 'pita ke-4 di pangkal awal sirip anal' render 'origin' as 'pangkal awal'. This is awkward; use 'awal pangkal sirip'. 'Pita pertama' also does not match 'anterior bar', which means the front bar.
Item 17: the sentence 'D. gemellus, D. johorensis ... pola pita hanya ada pada ikan muda' is fine. 'genus Desmopuntius dibentuk dan didiagnosis' is acceptable. 'Kesalahan penamaan' is fine.
Item 11: 'predator mikro' for 'micropredator' is acceptable. 'kutu air' for Daphnia is the common term, but 'Daphnia' is also used and readers may confuse it with other organisms.

Item 15: 'filter spons bertenaga aerator' and 'diisi air matang' are ambiguous. 'air matang' usually means boiled water in Indonesian; use 'air dari akuarium yang sudah matang/siklus' for 'mature water'.
Item 15: 'jangan' is missing nowhere, but 'tidak menunjukkan perawatan induk' is stiff; use 'tidak menjaga telur/anak'.
Item 1: 'sudah dewasa penuh' is stiff; use 'berukuran dewasa'. 'hasil tangkapan alam' is fine, but the hobby term 'tangkapan alam (wild)' is commoner.

desmopuntius-johorensis.name: Striped Barb
notes: Item 10: "air matang (dari akuarium yang sudah mapan)" – "air matang" means boiled water in Indonesian; use "air dari akuarium yang sudah mapan/matang (cycled)".
Item 11: ordinal inconsistency, "pita pertama" next to "pita ke-2", "ke-3"; use "pita ke-1" or consistent wording.
Item 11: "sungut rostral dan maksila ada" is awkward; use "terdapat sungut rostral dan maksila".
Item 2: "posisinya tampaknya digantikan oleh D. trifasciatus" is awkward; use "tampaknya digantikan oleh D. trifasciatus".

desmopuntius-rhomboocellatus.name: Snakeskin Barb
notes: Item 1: "Spesimen tangkapan alam dari Borneo yang sangat bagus." is a fragment with no verb. The source says specimens were received. Use a full sentence, e.g. "Kami menerima spesimen tangkapan alam yang bagus..." in neutral phrasing, such as "Diterima spesimen tangkapan alam yang sangat bagus dari Borneo."

Item 4: "Kahayan" differs from the English "Kahajan". It is the correct modern river name, so this is fine. The other place names keep the old spelling (Oelin, Bandjermasin), which matches the quoted type locality.
Item 13: "air akuarium yang sudah matang/siap (mature)" is clumsy. "mature water" means well-established, aged water. Use "air yang sudah matang" only.
Item 13: "keesokan paginya" is rendered with "biasanya", a hedge that is not in the source ("should take place"). Minor.
Item 14: "pangkal depan sirip punggung" for "dorsal-fin origin" is acceptable. "keranjang sampah" for "catch-all" is fine.
Item 10: "terlalu aktif/lincah" uses a slash. Choose one term, e.g. "terlalu aktif".
Item 3 was left out. The English is shop talk for customers, which the translator is told to drop, so this is not an error.

dichotomyctere-nigroviridis.name: Buntal Hijau
notes: Item 8: "lele Arius" – Arius are sea/brackish catfish; consider "ikan manyung (Arius)" or "patin laut/sembilang Arius" for hobbyist clarity.
Item 8: "Terutama ikan jantan, akan terus-menerus berkelahi" is awkward; use "Terutama ikan jantan akan terus-menerus berkelahi" (no comma) or "Pejantan khususnya akan berkelahi terus-menerus".
Item 5: "jadi ganti air sebagian secara rutin itu wajib" is colloquial; use "sehingga penggantian air sebagian secara rutin wajib dilakukan".
Item 8: "agresivitasnya agak terpecah" is slightly unnatural; use "agresi tersebar ke banyak ikan".

discherodontus-ashmeadi.name: Discherodontus ashmeadi
notes: Item 8: 'Males will also display their best colours as they compete' is rendered in the wrong sense. 'Ikan jantan juga akan menampilkan warna terbaiknya saat bersaing satu sama lain' is acceptable, but 'Damai ... tempat ia akan menghabiskan ... dan akan tumbuh baik' is one long run-on sentence and hard to read. Split it.
Item 3: 'tanaman emersed' leaves English untranslated. Use 'tanaman emers' or 'tanaman yang tumbuh menyembul di atas air'.

Item 3: 'Collection is therefore much easier during the hours of darkness' is rendered as 'penangkapannya jauh lebih mudah saat gelap'. This is fine, but 'ia' used for the fish in several places is slightly stiff.
Item 5: 'arus sederas air bah' for 'torrent-like conditions' overstates the meaning, since a flood is not a torrent. Use 'arus sederas aliran deras/jeram'.
Item 5: 'Microsorum, Bolbitis, atau Anubias' are left without italics. Make them genus names in italics (<em>) as Latin names.
Item 1/11: 'mudah stres (shock)' is imprecise. 'Shock' is better rendered as 'syok'. 'Stres' alone does not convey it.

Item 4: The 'Volume ±243 liter' is correct, but the dropped bracketed imperial values are fine. No change is needed, though 'sebaiknya menjadi ukuran minimum' is awkward. Use 'sebaiknya menjadi ukuran terkecil yang dipertimbangkan'.
Item 7: 'merumput biofilm' for 'browsing' is awkward. Use 'memakan/menggerogoti biofilm'. 'Daphnia' translated as 'kutu air' is acceptable but loses the Latin name hobbyists use, so keep 'Daphnia'.
Item 12: The Kottelat reference contains the typo 'bibiography' and is left untranslated as instructed. This is fine, so no change is needed.

epalzeorhynchos-bicolor.name: Red Tail Black Shark
notes: Item 3: "pembangunan manusia" is awkward and can read as human development. Use "pembangunan oleh manusia" or "aktivitas pembangunan".
Item 5: "cukup tidak tahan terhadap penumpukan limbah organik" is clumsy. Use "kurang tahan" or "sensitif terhadap".

Item 7: "pakan kering berkualitas baik berupa pakan serpihan, granul, serta bahan nabati segar" lumps fresh plant material in with dried food. Separate them: dried flakes and granules, plus fresh plant material.
Item 2: "dianggap kritis" is vague for "considered critically endangered". Use "dianggap sangat terancam punah (critically endangered)".

Item 1: "ikan cyprinid" and "Red tail black shark" are acceptable, but the common name is more natural as "red tail black shark" (also "hiu bala/balashark ekor merah"). Use the form hobbyists use consistently.

epalzeorhynchos-frenatus.name: Rainbow Shark
notes: Items 7 and 11: "menggerogoti" (gnaw) for "browse/graze" on algae and biofilm is slightly off. "memakan/mengerik" or "merumput" would fit better.
Item 1: "anerythristic" is left untranslated, though item 11 glosses it. Consider "anerythristic (tanpa pigmen merah)" here too.

epalzeorhynchos-kalopterus.name: Flying fox
notes: Item 1: "Flying fox bisa dengan mudah hidup 10–15 tahun" – the English "easily live up to 10-15 years" is rendered loosely; "hingga 10–15 tahun" is more faithful.
Item 2: "karena itu tangkapan alam relatif jarang diimpor" – the comma splice is awkward; use "sehingga" or "itulah sebabnya".
Item 5: "bisa suka bertengkar" is awkward; use "bisa agresif/suka berkelahi".
Item 5: "masalah ini jauh berkurang" is fine, but "perilaku ini bisa terbentuk" is vague; make clear it refers to the hierarchy and group behaviour.
Item 3: "Flying fox" is written in lowercase at the start of a sentence; capitalise it and use italics for the Latin name.

esomus-metallicus.name: Striped Flying Barb
notes: Item 12: "a dozen described Esomus species" is rendered "belasan spesies" (about 11–19). Use "selusin" or "sekitar 12 spesies" to stay close to the source.

Item 12: "tidak ada yang terlalu populer" is slightly weaker than "none are especially popular". "Tidak ada yang terlalu populer" is fine, but "sebagian besar umum dijumpai" would read more naturally as "sebagian besar tergolong umum".

eutropiichthys-burmannicus.name: Eutropiichthys burmannicus
notes: Item 1: size and temperature drop the original in brackets (14 in; 73-79°F). Dropping them is allowed because the metric conversion is given, so this is not an error.

Item 4: 'eutropheia = cukup makan' is fine, but 'jarang ditemukan di pasar ikan' is OK. 'Risiko Rendah (Least Concern)' is acceptable; the usual Indonesian term is 'Berisiko Rendah' or 'Resiko Rendah'.
Item 2: 'hilir Sungai Salween' reads slightly ambiguous. Consider 'bagian hilir Sungai Salween'.

garra-flavatra.name: Garra panda
notes: Item 8: 'Memelihara Garra flavatra sangat mudah' — the English says 'very easy', but this contradicts the rest of the text, which says it needs stable water and a mature set-up. It is faithful to the source, so only flag it if the source is wrong. Not a translation error.
Item 10: 'Parameter air lainnya tidak berpengaruh baginya' is a little too absolute. Prefer 'tidak penting bagi mereka'. This is a minor point.
Item 13: 'Mereka sepenuhnya damai' — fine. No change needed.
Item 6: 'batu kerikil bulat' for 'pebbles' is awkward; use 'kerikil' or 'batu kali'. 'Anak sungai' for 'stream' is acceptable but slightly imprecise; 'sungai kecil' is better.
Item 6: 'Dasarnya didominasi batu besar dan batu kecil' — 'rocks and stones' is rendered with 'batu besar', which adds a size claim. Use 'batu dan batu kecil'.
Item 6: 'Pengambilan ikan' for 'collection' is vague; 'penangkapan/pengumpulan ikan' is clearer.
Item 12: 'Tubifex' is rendered as 'cacing sutra'. That is acceptable but not identical; keep Tubifex or add it in brackets.
Item 12: 'kerang/udang yang dihaluskan' for 'puréed shellfish' adds 'udang' and is imprecise. Use 'kerang-kerangan/hewan bercangkang yang dihaluskan'.
Item 16: 'Direktur pelaksananya' — 'Managing Director' is better as 'Direktur Utama'.
Item 3 is left out, which matches the instructions for shop talk. No issue.

garra-rufa.name: Ikan Dokter
notes: Item 3: "Lapisan biofilm" for "Growth" adds a term not in the source; the source says algae and the microorganisms in it. Use "Lapisan alga" or "Tumbuhan penempel (alga) beserta mikroorganisme di dalamnya" instead.
Item 4: "batu-batu berlumut alga" is slightly off for "algae-covered stones". "batu yang ditumbuhi alga", as used in item 3, is more consistent.
Item 4: "Terutama ikan-ikan muda sangat rajin" is awkward for "Young fish in particular are very fond of...". Use "Ikan muda khususnya sangat gemar membersihkan dan memakan alga".

Item 5: "Saat dicoba langsung" loses the "self-experiment" meaning, which is the author trying it on their own arm. Use "Dalam percobaan pada diri sendiri", or a neutral wording such as "Dalam uji coba pada lengan sendiri".
Item 5: "dengan sendirinya berenang menghampiri tangan" is fine, but "pemakan alga yang hebat" is a bit colloquial. "pemakan alga yang andal" is more natural.
Item 2: "Ikan dokter" is a common name, but it is not the same as "psoriasis fish". Consider "ikan dokter (ikan psoriasis) Kangal" for clarity.

gnathonemus-petersii.name: Elephant Nose
notes: "saling keroyok, bahkan sampai ada yang mati" – "mob each other, even to death" is slightly softened; better "saling menyerang beramai-ramai, bahkan sampai mati". "keroyok" is colloquial.
"elephant nose" – the usual Indonesian hobby name is "ikan hidung gajah" (or "elephantnose"); consider using it.
"Padahal di alam" – "however" is better rendered as "Namun, di alam"; "padahal" implies contradiction/reproach and is slightly off.
"unik" for "bizarre" – "aneh" or "tidak biasa" is closer to the source.
"kawanan" and "bergerombol" for schools/schooling – "kawanan" is usually for land animals; "gerombolan" is more natural for fish shoals.

gymnarchus-niloticus.name: Aba Aba
notes: #5: "ditanam atau diberi pemberat" adds "ditanam" (planted), which the source doesn't say. Use "diberi pemberat dengan kuat" or "dikunci/ditahan dengan kokoh".
#3: "lahan basah" is a broad term for wetlands in general. For "marshes" use "paya" or "rawa-rawa".

#11: "Karena sirip punggungnya yang memanjang... padahal" in #1 and "pencinta ikan predator monster" in #11 are loose. "Tankbusting" means fish that outgrow and wreck tanks, so "ikan predator raksasa perusak akuarium" is closer.

gymnocorymbus-ternetzi.name: Black Widow
notes: #8: 'manfish' is wrong for 'angel fish'; use 'angelfish' (atau 'ikan manfish' hanya jika dikenal) — better 'angelfish/skalar'.
#4: '20g long' dropped; '(sekitar 70 liter)' fine, but 'standar' ok. Minor: ensure 70 L retained as stated (it is).
#1/#11: 'ikan karasin (Characidae)' – 'karasin' is non-standard for hobbyists; use 'characid' or 'famili Characidae'.
#11: 'cukup 'black tetra'' is awkward for 'simply black tetra'; use 'atau sekadar 'black tetra''.
#11: 'nama dagang' for 'common names' should be 'nama umum'.
#5: 'Cukup tidak rewel soal dekorasi' is awkward; use 'Tidak terlalu rewel soal dekorasi'.
#7: 'pelet butiran' adds 'pelet'; source says granules – use 'granul'. 'kutu air' for Daphnia is ok, but 'Daphnia' commonly used.
#10: 'java moss' and 'spawning mop (media pemijahan dari benang)' adds explanation; acceptable but 'lumut jawa' is the local term.
#10: 'Dengan jumlah sebanyak itu' fine; 'indukan harus segera dipindahkan' ok. 'burayak' is acceptable but 'anakan' is more common among hobbyists.
#3: 'kali' redundant with 'anak sungai'; 'creeks' ok but streamline.

gyrinocheilus-aymonieri.name: Chinese Algae Eater
notes: Item 1: "Umurnya bisa lebih dari 15 tahun, dan sebagian besar tidak cocok untuk akuarium komunitas" – the subject is ambiguous; better "ikan ini sebagian besar tidak cocok untuk..." or "kurang cocok untuk...".
Item 3: "kerikil kecil, kerikil" for "pebbles, gravel" is a little repetitive; consider "kerikil besar/koral, kerikil".

hampala-dispar.name: Spotted Hampala Barb
notes: Item 1: 'Needs a tank at least 2 m long' vs 'Aquarium size: 240 × 60 cm' is fine, but the ID 'Butuh arus kuat, dengan filter yang memutar air akuarium 8–12 kali per jam' is OK; no issue. Main problem is in item 8: 'ikan teri (whitebait)' is wrong; teri are anchovies, whitebait are juvenile herring/sprats. Use 'ikan kecil utuh (whitebait)'.
Item 8: 'ikan mas koki kecil' for 'small goldfish' is acceptable, but 'pack-style behaviour' became 'kawanan pemburu', which adds 'hunting'. Use 'perilaku berkelompok seperti kawanan'.

Item 8: 'Hampala spp. ... dalam jumlah lebih sedikit' in item 12 changes meaning: 'to a lesser extent, H. dispar' means H. dispar is seen less often, so it is OK; but item 8 'ditambah sebagian ikan kecil' is fine.
Item 12: 'di Kalimantan' placed after 'Malaysia' is garbled. Say 'negara bagian Sarawak di Kalimantan, Malaysia'.
Item 12: 'bentuk H. bimaculata ... sebaiknya dianggap berbeda' loses the 'ought to be considered distinct [species]' nuance. Say 'dianggap sebagai spesies tersendiri'.
Item 12: 'pada dua spesies lainnya terletak di bawah pangkal awal sirip punggung' is slightly redundant. Use 'di bawah pangkal sirip punggung'.

Item 5: the '~864 litres' volume is correct, but 'Spesies aktif yang hidup di kolom air terbuka (pelagis)' is a loose rendering of 'pelagic'. Use 'ikan pelagis aktif yang berenang di kolom air tengah-atas'.
Item 9: 'shoaling (berkumpul longgar)' and 'schooling (berenang serempak)' are acceptable, but 'ikan yang kalah dominan' is awkward. Use 'ikan subdominan'.
Item 6: 'setup' and 'mudah kaget' are fine, but 'skittish' as 'cukup mudah kaget' is OK; 'substrat batu dan kerikil berbagai ukuran' is fine. Item 1: the 'SL 35 cm' conversion is right.

hampala-salweenensis.name: Hampala Salween
notes: Item 8: "ikan yang rewel makan" is fine, but "Hampala ... disarankan sebagai teman satu akuarium" changes the subject: the original says the fish is recommended as a tankmate for fussy/new fishes, which is kept, but "segerombolan" for "a shoal" is fine. The real error is "feeder" fish: "ikan mas koki kecil" is OK. Check "pakan hidup (feeder)": feeder fish are live fish, so say "ikan umpan (feeder fish)" rather than "pakan hidup", which wrongly suggests all live foods.
Item 6: the sentence "Ikan ini juga paling baik dipelihara ... " is fine. "mudah kaget" for skittish is okay, but "cabang kayu (driftwood)" should be "kayu apung/kayu rendam" or just driftwood.
Item 12: "dilewati gurat sisi" is awkward for "passing through lateral line"; use "tepat pada gurat sisi" or "menutupi gurat sisi".
Item 12: "ikan lele/catfish" and "Cyprinid, characid" are left as English-style terms; use "ikan lele" and consider "ikan karpet (cyprinid)" only if needed.
Item 12: "di Kalimantan (Borneo)" is awkward; Sarawak is in northern Borneo (Kalimantan is Indonesian), so write "di Pulau Borneo".
Item 12: "tanda di tubuh cenderung memudar pada ikan yang sangat besar pada semua Hampala spp." has double "pada"; rephrase.
Item 1: the "201 mm SL" figure is unchanged, which is correct, but SL is not explained anywhere; consider "panjang standar".
Item 3: the type locality is left in English with a translation in brackets, which is acceptable; "anak Sungai" is fine.

hasemania-nana.name: Silver Tip Tetra
notes: Item 1: "All the fish in the trade are captive bred and unfussy ... and it is sometimes sold" — fine, but 'copper tetra' left in English is acceptable; consider adding local explanation "tetra tembaga".

Item 3: "perairan air putih (white water) maupun air hitam (black water)" is redundant/awkward; use "perairan air putih (white water) maupun air hitam (black water)" → "perairan berair putih ... dan berair hitam" or "air putih" without 'perairan'.
Item 4: "Alas akuarium" is slightly stiff; "Ukuran alas akuarium" or "Dimensi dasar akuarium" is more natural.
Item 5: "dan akar-akar yang meliuk" for 'twisted roots' ok; "daun ek dan daun beech" — 'beech' left untranslated; use "daun beech (bukit)" or explain; minor.
Item 7: "pakan kering berupa pakan serpihan dan pelet butiran" repetitive; use "pakan kering berupa flake dan granul".
Item 8: "gurami hias" fine; "Loricariidae" capitalised as family not italic—fine; "suka menggigit sirip" ok. "angelfish" could be "ikan manfish/angelfish"; minor.

helostoma-temminckii.name: Tambakan
notes: Item 1: 'Tambakan atau kissing gourami' — adds a local name that is not in the source; also 'famili Helostomatidae' is added. 'Tambakan' is the established local name, but the added family name is not in this sentence.
Item 1: 'Bentuk putih kemerahan' for 'pinkish-white' is okay, but item 11 then says 'Bentuk pink' — use one term consistently.
Item 8: 'ikan lele/catfish' — the source says 'catfishes' (a broad group), and 'lele' is a specific catfish; use 'ikan berkumis/catfish' or just 'catfish'.

Item 5: 'Pencahayaan relatif tidak penting ... lumut/alga jangan dibasmi' — acceptable, but 'mengambil udara dari permukaan' is fine. 'saluran keluar' for 'outflows' is slightly clumsy. 'merumput biofilm' is odd; use 'memakan/menggerus biofilm'.
Item 7: 'Bibirnya yang tebal' — the source says 'fleshy lips'; 'berdaging' is closer. 'mengecap' for 'mouthing' is unnatural; use 'membuka-tutup mulut'.
Item 7: 'Tubifex' translated as 'cacing sutra' — fine, but 'Tapis insang' / 'lengkung insang' are not clearly rendered as 'gill rakers' and 'gill arches' to hobbyists.

hemigrammus-bleheri.name: Rummy Nose Tetra
notes: Item 12: "Tulang frontal kiri dan kanan saling bersentuhan" adds "kiri dan kanan", which is not in the source ("Contact between frontals").

Item 12: "17 atau lebih sedikit jari-jari sirip anal bercabang" is fine, but "tepi posterodorsal ... tidak bersentuhan (berjarak)" reads awkwardly and the source is unclear. Check this against the source.
Item 12: "warna merahnya melewati tutup insang" is OK. However, "lobus sirip ekor yang dipisahkan oleh pita berwarna putih" is ambiguous. Specify that the bars are separated by white bands.
Item 12: "tidak dapat dideklinasikan" is a stiff, unnatural literal rendering. Use "tidak mengalami perubahan bentuk (indeclinable)".
Item 4: "kelompok 10 ekor, lebih baik lagi kalau lebih banyak" is fine. "Karena sifatnya yang aktif berenang" is acceptable.
Item 8: "Anabantoid" and "Loricariidae kecil" are inconsistent. Use "anabantid/labirin" and "loricariid kecil".
Item 10: "sekitar enam ekor dari masing-masing jenis kelamin" is OK. "Dengan jumlah yang baik" is awkward.
Item 11: "Uniknya" adds emphasis not in the source. "Precisely in a tetra" is rendered loosely.

hemigrammus-erythrozonus.name: Glowlight Tetra
notes: "sejauh ini hanya diketahui" (items 1 and 2) adds a hedge the English doesn't have. Use "hanya diketahui dari".
"manfish" for angel fish is acceptable. "angelfish" is the more common hobby spelling and could be added in brackets.
"ternakan massal" and "hasil ternakan" read slightly stiff. "hasil penangkaran massal" is more natural.

hemirhamphodon-pogonognathus.name: Julung-julung
notes: Item 5: "teman setanknya tidak boleh terlalu kasar" – "setank" is non-standard; use "penghuni akuarium lain" or "ikan lain dalam akuarium yang sama". "robust" is better rendered "terlalu bongsor/agresif/aktif" than "kasar".
Item 5: "Sesama jantan bisa cukup sering berkelahi" adds "sering" (frequency); the source says quite quarrelsome, so use "cukup suka berkelahi".

Item 2: "tidak tahan pengiriman" is stiff; use "tidak tahan terhadap pengangkutan/transportasi". "kondisi ... hampir tidak mendukung kehidupan" is fine but "miskin" for food supply could be "minim nutrisi".
Item 2: "aklimatisasi" is good, but "Terutama, ikan ini..." is awkward; use "Ikan ini terutama tidak tahan...".
Item 4: "dimakan dengan lahap" slightly strengthens "with pleasure"; "dimakan dengan senang hati/mau memakan" would be closer.

hemisilurus-moolenburghi.name: Lais
notes: Item 1: "Data Deficient/Kekurangan Data" – use the standard Indonesian form "Kekurangan Data (Data Deficient)"; slash format is awkward.
Item 1: "orang yang mengoleksi ikan ini" – better "yang mengoleksi spesimen ikan ini" / "kolektornya".
Item 1: "Ukuran maksimum: 500 mm SL" – 500 mm could be given as 50 cm for hobbyist readability; "SL" explained is fine.
Item 4: "juluran berbulu seperti bulu ayam" adds "seperti bulu ayam" (like chicken feathers), which is not in the source; use "juluran berbulu halus" (feathery extensions).
Item 4: "punya" is colloquial in a handbook; prefer "memiliki". "tutup insang" is fine for opercle.
Item 5: Redundant repetition "belum dilaporkan. Belum ada laporan pemijahan" mirrors the source; could be merged, minor.

herichthys-carpintis.name: Green Texas
notes: Item 4: in "P 120 cm × T 45 cm × L 37,5 cm", "L" for lebar is easy to confuse with L for litre. Consider writing "Lebar" in full or using "P × L × T" with the words spelled out.
Item 10: "telur/larva" adds a word that is not in the source (it says only "they"). Use "telur" alone.

heros-severus.name: Severum
notes: "agak sadah" for "medium hard": use "sadah sedang" (or "kesadahan sedang"); "agak sadah" slightly shifts the meaning.
"Hal ini terutama karena perilaku berkembang biaknya": "berkembang biak" is awkward. Use "perilaku pemijahannya" or "cara berbiaknya".
"mengerami telur di mulut (mouthbreeding)": hobbyists usually say "mouthbrooder" or "pengeram mulut". Also, "bertelur di substrat" is vague; "memijah di substrat (substrate breeder)" is better.
"Amazon, Orinoco": add "Sungai" or "DAS" (e.g., "Sungai Amazon, Sungai Orinoco") so the reader knows these are river systems.
"warnanya mungkin jadi memudar": "jadi" is colloquial; use "menjadi" in the formal handbook register.
"Ikan juga bisa lebih rentan" and "tanda-tanda kondisi yang menurun": stiff and vague. Use "tanda-tanda penurunan kondisi" or "kesehatannya menurun".
"Pakan nabati perlu ditambahkan": the source says "vegetarian components". "Komponen nabati" or "pakan berbahan nabati" is closer. "pelet stik" for "sticks" is fine, but "stik" alone is enough.

homaloptera-parclitella.name: Lizard Loach
notes: Item 3: 'Jadi spesies yang layak dipelihara' for 'recommendable species' is awkward; also the 'we were able' import claim is rendered passively, which is acceptable, but 'Loach cantik ini mutlak' is fine. Main issue is only minor wording.
Item 12: 'pertarungan pamer' for 'comment fights' (Komment fights, ritualised display fights) is unnatural; use 'perkelahian ritual/adu pamer' with a clearer explanation.
Item 9: 'batu dan kerikil sungai yang halus terkikis air' is awkward; use 'batu dan kerikil sungai yang halus terkikis air' → 'batu dan kerikil bulat berbagai ukuran yang terkikis arus'.
Item 9: 'aufwuchs (lapisan alga dan mikroorganisme)' is a German term left in place in items 9 and 11; use 'aufwuchs' with a gloss consistently, or 'lapisan alga/biofilm'.
Item 9: 'Turnover ... 10–15 times' conflicts with item 2 (8–12) in the source itself; this is not a translation error, but 'jadi bila perlu' adds a slightly different logic to 'so ... as necessary'.
Item 16: the translation is missing entirely (left out). The stock code and wholesale note were dropped; if the shop talk is intentionally dropped this is fine, but confirm it.
Item 13: 'lele Glyptothorax, Akysis, dan Oreoglanis spp.' calls the catfishes 'lele', which usually means Clarias; use 'ikan lele-lelean' or 'catfish'.
Item 11: 'kutu air' for Daphnia is acceptable, but 'merumput biofilm' is awkward; use 'memakan biofilm dengan cara merumput'.

hyphessobrycon-amandae.name: Ember Tetra
notes: Item 13: 'very boisterous' is translated as 'sangat agresif'. This changes the meaning; use 'sangat lincah/heboh'.
Item 13: 'tidak akan mampu bersaing' turns 'will not compete well' into an absolute. Use 'kurang mampu bersaing'.
Item 5: 'perairan tenang di tepi sungai (backwater)' is wordy. 'Danau tapal kuda' is acceptable for oxbow, but 'danau oxbow' is also common.
Item 3: 'tidak terganggu' is weaker than 'not affected'. 'Most available' is also unclear. Use 'tidak terdampak'.
Item 7: 'ikan mas koki' is fine, but 'Mungkin tidak perlu sesering membersihkan akuarium ikan mas koki' is awkward. Rephrase it.
Item 12: 'Soal teman satu akuarium' is colloquial. 'Tankmate' is usually written 'tank mate' or 'penghuni akuarium lain'. Also 'bergerombol' vs 'berkelompok' is inconsistent.
Item 17: 'pemijah bebas yang menebar telur' is clumsy. 'Egg-scattering free spawner' is better as 'penebar telur'.
Item 1: the minimum tank size 'sekitar 38 liter' converts 10 gallons correctly, but the item 6 volume is a separate figure. Check that the two sizes are consistent.
Item 10: 'Anda' is used here but not elsewhere, and the register is inconsistent. 'Ikan muda dan indukan' is fine.

hyphessobrycon-eques.name: Serpae tetra
notes: Item 4: "Bagaimanapun, ini ikan yang cantik" renders "after all" awkwardly; better "Lagi pula, ikan ini memang cantik".
Item 4: "warna merah bening seperti kristal" for "crystal-red color" is slightly interpretive; consider "merah kristal".
Item 3: "merobek sirip" is too strong for "ruffle each other's fins"; use "saling mengusik/menggigiti sirip".
Item 3: "cukup jarang semua ikan ... siripnya utuh" is clumsy; rephrase, e.g. "jarang sekali seluruh ikan di akuarium memiliki sirip utuh sekaligus".
Item 2: "peternakan" for "breeding facility" is slightly off; "tempat pembiakan/penangkaran" is more natural.
Item 2: "strain andalan" for "house strain" is loose; "strain khas sendiri" is closer.
Item 4: "Brillant" is kept as in the source; fine, but "veil" varieties might be "bersirip layar/panjang" consistently.

hyphessobrycon-herbertaxelrodi.name: Black Neon Tetra
notes: Item 5: "ditanami tanaman air dengan rimbun" is awkward and redundant. Use "ditanami rimbun" or "penuh tanaman air".
Item 8: "direncanakan dengan baik" is a loose rendering of "well-researched". Something like "yang dirancang dengan matang" is more precise.
Item 11: "garis tengah lateral" is a stiff rendering of "midlateral stripe". Use "garis tengah badan" or "garis lateral tengah".

hyphessobrycon-megalopterus.name: Black phantom tetra
notes: Item 3: "kutu air (Daphnia, Moina)" is wrong in meaning for a hobby handbook; Daphnia is usually "kutu air" but Moina is "kutu air" too, so this is acceptable. Better to keep Daphnia and Moina as in the source without the generic gloss.
Item 1/11: "Sebagian besar catatannya" and "dibudidayakan" are fine. Better to use "tulang postorbital" and "bintik humeral" with the usual "bintik bahu" gloss for readability.

Item 2: "anak sungai utama rio Mamoré" for "main affluent" is fine. "yang mengalirkan air dari lahan basah" reverses the sense: the Guaporé drains the Pantanal wetland, so "yang menguras/mengalirkan air lahan basah tropis" would be clearer.

Item 8: "well-researched community aquarium" became "penghuninya sudah dipilih dengan cermat". This slightly changes the meaning. A closer rendering is "akuarium komunitas yang direncanakan dengan matang".
Item 10: "Karena itu, perilakunya lebih menarik dan warnanya lebih bagus" is fine. "Alas plastik model 'rumput'" is a bit vague, so write "matras plastik tipe 'rumput'".

hyphessobrycon-pulchripinnis.name: Lemon Tetra
notes: Item 8: 'each fish soon occupies a tiny territory' is rendered correctly, but 'Memelihara semua jenis lemon tetra' is fine. No change needed here; ignore.
Item 4: 'rio Tapajós basins' / 'municipalities' rendered as 'munisipalitas' – use 'kota/kabupaten (munisipalitas)' for natural Indonesian.
Item 17: 'crystal red' translated as 'merah jernih berkilau' – adds 'berkilau'; use 'merah jernih'.
Item 17: 'Pada Muzel tetra kuning, bercak humeral (di belakang tutup insang)' adds a fact not in the source ('di belakang tutup insang'); remove or keep only 'bercak humeral'.
Item 14: 'well-researched community aquarium' is translated as 'penghuninya dipilih berdasarkan riset yang matang'; simplify to 'akuarium komunitas yang direncanakan dengan baik'.
Item 18: 'Zarske, 2008)[12]' kept; fine. But 'Weitzman & Palmer ... kemonofiletikannya' is awkward; use 'kemonofiletikan kelompok ini'.
Item 3: 'Jacare Acanga' versus 'Jacareacanga' in item 4 – spelling inconsistency between items (source also differs, but harmonise).

hyphessobrycon-rosaceus.name: Rosy Tetra
notes: "tampangnya sangat mirip": too colloquial for a handbook; use "penampilannya sangat mirip".
"tetra ini tetap berenang di akuarium": too literal; use "masih dipelihara di akuarium".
"dibiakkan oleh beberapa peternak": use "penangkar/pembiak" (hobbyist breeders), not "peternak" (livestock farmers).
"Ini bagus, karena dari Guyana... tidak ada impor atau hanya sangat sesekali": awkward and unclear; rephrase, e.g. "impor hanya terjadi sangat jarang atau tidak ada sama sekali".
"tetra phantom": better to follow the Indonesian hobby term order, e.g. "phantom tetra" like "rosy tetra"; the text is inconsistent.
"sailed under this name" → "Nama itu dipakai": the idiom is lost; this is acceptable but rather flat.

hyphessobrycon-sweglesi.name: Red Phantom Tetra
notes: Item 13: 'Hyphessobrycon was raised ... as a subgenus of Hemigrammus' is translated 'didirikan'; 'raised' means erected, but the meaning is slightly lost. Prefer 'ditetapkan sebagai subgenus'.
Item 13: 'an irregular row of 9-10 premaxillary teeth' is rendered as 'satu baris tidak teratur'. 'Satu' is an addition, and the Indonesian reads as if there were one row only.
Item 13: 'sangat berwarna' for 'particularly colourful' is awkward. Use 'sangat mencolok warnanya'.
Item 13: 'tinggi tubuh 2,71–2,90 kali dalam panjang standar' is awkward. Use 'tinggi tubuh sekitar 2,71–2,90 kali lebih pendek dari SL', or 'masuk 2,71–2,90 kali dalam SL'.
Item 11: 'filter spons bertenaga aerator' and 'air matang' are ambiguous. 'Mature water' means aged, established water. Use 'air yang sudah matang/berumur' or 'air dari akuarium yang sudah mapan'.
Item 9: 'well-researched community aquarium' is rendered 'penghuninya dipilih dengan cermat'. This is acceptable but slightly shifts the meaning. Say 'yang direncanakan dengan matang'.

Item 12: 'prone to infusorios' is rendered as 'rentan terhadap infusoria'. The original likely means they are fed infusoria, or are prone to infusoria-type problems. The sentence is unclear, so check that 'rentan' is right. Also 'sebisa mungkin membutuhkan pakan hidup' is garbled word order.
Item 4: 'minor tributaries, smaller rivers' is rendered 'anak sungai kecil, sungai-sungai yang lebih kecil'. This is acceptable. 'Sering dikaitkan dengan' is stiff. Use 'sering dijumpai di'.
Item 4: 'banjir yang sangat besar' for 'extreme flooding' is mild. Use 'banjir ekstrem'.

inpaichthys-kerri.name: Blue Emperor Tetra
notes: Item 10: "pada sore atau malam hari" adds "sore atau"; the source says only "in the evening", so use "pada malam hari" or "pada sore hari".
Item 8: "kalah bersaing dengan teman setangki yang lebih agresif" drops the idea of "will not compete well" (as a caution). Consider "tidak mampu bersaing dengan ... yang lebih agresif".

kryptopterus-cryptopterus.name: Ikan lais
notes: Item 1: "Size: 200 mm (7.9 in) SL" -> "20 cm SL" is correct, but "Lokasi tipe: ... Kalimantan Selatan, Kalimantan" is fine; main issue is elsewhere.
Item 3: temperature range "22.0-27.0°C (71.6-80.6°F)" lost the Fahrenheit original; acceptable, but 22–27 °C is fine, so no change needed.
Item 5: "Mau langsung menyantap" is awkward and slightly changes meaning of 'readily feeds'; use "Mudah menerima pakan hidup/beku dan pakan buatan lain seperti pelet".
Item 9: added explanation "(sangat kecil/tidak berkembang)" is not in the source; remove the added gloss or keep just "rudimenter".
Item 6: "kelompok minimal tiga ekor" is fine, but "lele Asia" for catfishes and "Teman satu akuarium" are okay; no change needed.

kryptopterus-vitreolus.name: Lele kaca
notes: "karena arah cahaya dan gerakan ikan harus pas betul" – the source says "the interaction of light and movement of the fish must fit exactly"; consider "interaksi cahaya dan gerakan ikan harus pas" to stay closer to the original.

"seorang penghobi bergelar sarjana biologi" – the source says "a keeper with a degree in biology"; fine in meaning, but "pemelihara" or "aquascaper" is not needed. Keep "penghobi" and consider "lulusan biologi" as more natural.
"Dari kebiasaan ini" – the source says "In this context"; "Dalam kegiatan ini" would be more faithful, since it was not a habit that led to the discovery.

labidochromis-caeruleus.name: Labidochromis caeruleus
notes: Item 11: "cichlid Danau Rift" reads as if the lake is called Rift. Use "cichlid danau-danau Rift Valley" or "cichlid Great Rift Lakes".
Item 10: "memuntahkan telur/burayak" mixes two terms. Use "memuntahkan telur atau burayak".
Item 7: "mau menerima sebagian besar pakan" is slightly stiff. Use "mau memakan sebagian besar jenis pakan".

macropodus-opercularis.name: Ikan Paradise
notes: Item 12: "cacing sutra" for "blackworms" is inexact. Cacing sutra is usually Tubifex, and blackworms are Lumbriculus. Use "blackworm" or "cacing hitam".
Item 8: "kayu apung" for "Driftwood" can be read as wood that floats. Use "kayu driftwood" or "kayu rendaman".
Item 14: "urutan hierarki" is redundant for "pecking order". Use "hierarki dominansi" or "urutan dominansi".
Item 2: "LC (Risiko Rendah)" would be better as "Berisiko Rendah", the usual Indonesian wording for Least Concern.

marosatherina-ladigesi.name: Beseng-beseng
notes: #10: "bertelur beberapa butir setiap hari" adds "a few"; the source says only "batches of eggs each day" (e.g. "bertelur dalam beberapa kelompok setiap hari" or just "bertelur setiap hari").
#10: "pakan yang melayang" for "free swimming foods" is slightly off; "pakan hidup yang aktif berenang" would be closer.
#1/#11: "peternakan (ikan)" for fish farms is unusual; hobbyists say "tempat budidaya" or "penangkaran".
#7: "ia mau menerima" is stiff; "mau memakan" is more natural.

mastacembelus-armatus.name: Tilan Tire Track
notes: Item 5: "spiny eel sering suka membenamkan diri" is redundant (sering + suka); use "sering membenamkan diri" or "cenderung suka".
Item 5: "air payau ringan" is awkward; use "air payau dengan salinitas rendah" (or "sedikit payau").

Item 1/11: "Tilan tire track" mixes local and English; the English name is left untranslated and the Indonesian term "tilan" is used inconsistently across items (e.g. "peacock eel" and "Tanganyikan spiny eel" stay in English). Consider "belut duri" or "tilan" consistently, with English in brackets.
Item 5: "Tutup akuarium yang rapat wajib dipakai" is stiff; rephrase to "Akuarium wajib ditutup rapat".
Item 7: "lancefish" and "krill" are left in English without a gloss; add "ikan lancefish (sand lance)" or a local equivalent.
Item 7: "menopang ikan yang sudah besar" is awkward; use "memenuhi kebutuhan gizi ikan yang sudah besar".
Item 4: "Panjang standar 91 cm" is correct, but the volume is stated without litre/gallon context. This is fine, so no change is needed here beyond smoothing the wording.
Item 3: "sungai kecil" for "streams" is fine, but "sungai kecil maupun besar" slightly changes "streams and rivers"; use "anak sungai dan sungai".

mastacembelus-erythrotaenia.name: Fire Eel
notes: Item 1/11: "ikan sili (spiny eel)" is a dubious local name. Family Mastacembelidae is usually called "ikan tilan" or "belut duri" (sili is a different fish). Use "tilan"/"belut duri".
Item 5: "ikan sili sering suka membenamkan diri" is redundant (sering suka). Also use the same term as elsewhere. Suggest "sering membenamkan diri".
Item 5: "ditanami tanaman air dengan rapat" is awkward. Suggest "ditanami cukup rimbun".
Item 7: "lancefish" is left untranslated. Add a local equivalent such as "ikan lance (sand lance)".
Item 8: "teman satu akuarium cukup besar" is fine, but "sesamanya" for conspecifics is vague. Use "sesama spesiesnya".
Item 10: "berhasil berkembang biak" is stronger than the source. Suggest "pernah berkembang biak" or "memijah". Also change "Sesekali pernah" to "Pernah sesekali".
Item 4: "±432 liter" uses ± where the source has ~. Use "sekitar 432 liter".

maylandia-estherae.name: Red Zebra
notes: Item 10: "Care must be taken, if you decide to move the fish... harassment by the males" is rendered as "memindahkan betina... betina tidak diganggu jantan", which narrows the meaning. The source says the fish in general, not only the female.

Item 10: "dissipate this aggression" became "menyebarkan agresi". That is fine, but the sentence "Jantan cukup agresif saat mengejar betina" slightly changes the nuance of "quite vigorous in his pursuits".
Item 10: "Maternal mouthbrooder" became "pengeram mulut induk betina". This is awkward; use "pengeram mulut (mouthbrooder) oleh induk betina".

Item 10: "Some breeders artificially strip the fry... at the 2 week stage" became "mengeluarkan burayak secara paksa". "Secara paksa" is too harsh for an artificial method; use "secara manual/buatan".
Item 11: "Mbuna yang memang pantas populer" is stiff. Use "Mbuna yang populer dan memang layak".

Item 11: "jantan oranye dan OB" (item 1) says "orange and OB males occur", but "yellow or OB females" is missing from item 1. That is acceptable as a summary, but the item 11 and item 1 colour descriptions are inconsistent.
Item 8: "The tank should be overcrowded" was rendered with the English term "(overcrowded)" in brackets. "Padat tebar" would be the more natural hobby term.
Item 8: "peace loving species" became "spesies yang damai". The wording is fine, but "Peacock atau Utaka" should be clarified as cichlid groups.
Item 3: "karang-karang batu" is awkward for "reefs" in a freshwater lake. Use "area bebatuan/terumbu batu".
Item 1: "bisa kawin silang (hibrida)" is a clumsy use of the noun "hibrida". Use "bisa berhibridisasi".

melanotaenia-boesemani.name: Rainbow Boesemani
notes: Item 8: "ikan lele seperti Corydoras" is imprecise. Hobbyists would write "corydoras" or "lele hias (catfish) seperti Corydoras".
Item 10: "pakan yang melayang di air" for "free swimming foods" is slightly off. Better "pakan hidup yang berenang bebas seperti naupli artemia".
Item 11: "sangat dirugikan oleh perdagangan ikan hias" is a little loose. A clearer rendering is "perdagangan ikan hias berdampak sangat buruk pada spesies ini".

melanotaenia-praecox.name: Rainbow Praecox
notes: Item 10: 'filter kecil bertenaga aerator (filter busa/sponge)' adds a fact not in the source (sponge filter). Say 'filter kecil berpenggerak udara'.
Item 10: 'pakan yang melayang di air' for 'free swimming foods' changes the meaning. It should be live food that moves freely, such as 'pakan hidup yang berenang bebas'.

Item 10: 'Jumlah burayak per pemijahan biasanya sedikit lebih banyak' is a slightly altered reading. The source says brood size is a little larger than other rainbowfish. Wording should be 'jumlah anakan'.
Item 8: 'ikan karakin (tetra dan sejenisnya)' adds a gloss not in the source. Use 'karasin' or just 'characin'.
Item 8: 'gampang kaget' and 'ikan lele-lelean' are casual. Use 'mudah kaget' and 'lele seperti Corydoras'.
Item 1: 'Neon dwarf rainbowfish' is left untranslated. Add the local name 'ikan pelangi neon kerdil' or 'pelangi neon'.
Item 1: 'Papua (Pulau Nugini)' differs from the source's 'New Guinea', and Mamberamo is in Papua. It is correct but an added detail; keep it consistent.
Item 9: 'badan jantan menjadi jauh lebih tinggi' is acceptable but 'lebih tinggi' may be read as height; 'berbadan lebih dalam/lebar' is clearer.

microdevario-kubotai.name: Rasbora Kubotai
notes: Item 6: the English sentence 'In the Suriya the water is well-oxygenated, slightly turbid' is rendered correctly, but 'Such habitats tend to comprise transparent water' became 'berair jernih'. That is fine. The real problem is item 8: 'biologically immature set-up' became 'siklus nitrogennya belum matang'. This adds detail, but it is acceptable. A fuller fix is 'akuarium yang belum matang secara biologis'.

Item 1: 'maximum size of around 2.5 to 4 cm (1 to 1.5 inches)' was kept as 2,5–4 cm. That is correct. However, 'kadang bisa cukup merepotkan' for 'can make them difficult at times' is vague. Use 'kadang sulit dipelihara'.
Item 3: 'Mae Khlong and Mae Klong' are the same river spelled two ways. 'daerah aliran anak sungai Mae Khlong dan Mae Klong' reads oddly, but it matches the source, so leave it.

Item 4: the type locality is left entirely in English, including the coordinate '98°41'11'E'. It is untranslated English in running text. Translate the descriptive words ('Khlong Phrae Sai di Ban Kreo Noi, kilometer 8 pada jalan bercabang ke timur, 32 kilometer di utara Ranong ...') and keep the place names.
Item 4: 'daerah hulu Khwae Noi' for 'upper Khwae Noi watershed' drops 'watershed'. Use 'daerah aliran Sungai Khwae Noi bagian hulu'.
Item 11: 'aquascape hardscape' is awkward and does not mean a hardscape-only tank. Use 'akuarium dengan hardscape (batu dan kayu)'.
Item 15: 'paling baik dipelihara sendiri (tanpa spesies lain)' is slightly ambiguous. 'sendiri' could be read as a single fish. Use 'dipelihara satu spesies saja'.
Item 16: 'bertubuh lebih tinggi' for 'deeper-bodied' is acceptable. 'lebih ramping' for the males is not in the source ('more compact'). Use 'lebih kompak'.
Item 7: 60 × 30 cm base at 54 litres is plausible only for a ~30 cm tall tank. Check that the figure matches the source.

mikrogeophagus-ramirezi.name: Ramirezi
notes: Item 8: "sekitar 60 cm" for "a couple of feet across" is acceptable, but "lebar" is odd; use "berdiameter sekitar 60 cm".
Item 9: "kemerahmudaan" is non-standard and awkward; use "bercak merah muda".
Item 5: "siklus nitrogennya belum matang" is fine, but "biologically immature" is more commonly "belum matang secara biologis / belum cycling"; consider adding "(cycling)".
Item 5: "tidak satu pun berasal dari Amerika Selatan" is correct; "ganti air dalam jumlah sangat besar sebaiknya dihindari" reads clumsy, use "hindari pergantian air dalam volume sangat besar".
Item 10: "memakan telur atau anaknya" adds "or fry" (source says brood, so acceptable), but "mikroworm" should be "cacing mikro (microworm)".
Item 7: "kutu air" for Daphnia is acceptable, but "Daphnia" is the usual hobby term; "kerang-kerangan" for shellfish is vague (could include crustaceans), use "kerang dan udang-udangan/seafood".
Item 11: "klad" is unusual for hobbyists; use "klade". "Kullander (1998) memakai Mikrogeophagus ... sedangkan Microgeophagus sensu Frey ..." slightly alters the sentence flow but meaning kept.
Item 1: "Ram atau ramirezi" adds a name not in the source ("The ram"); acceptable but could be "Ram" only.

moenkhausia-sanctaefilomenae.name: Red Eye Tetra
notes: Item 11: "pada sore atau malam hari" adds "sore"; the English says only "in the evening", so use "pada malam hari" or "menjelang malam".
Item 3: "Inggris" for "the UK" is slightly imprecise; "Britania Raya" or "Inggris (UK)" would be more exact.

monodactylus-sebae.name: Mono Sebae
notes: Item 1: "bisa berpindah dengan bebas" is fine, but "hasil penangkaran" for "offspring" is acceptable; consider "keturunan hasil budidaya" for naturalness.
Item 2: "sudah memijah" for "are spawning" is okay; "troop" rendered as "kelompok" is fine, but consider "gerombolan" (schooling term) for hobby usage.

Item 5: "memijah bebas tanpa merawat anakan" — "free spawners" is better as "penebar telur (free spawner) tanpa perawatan induk"; "telurnya melayang bebas" slightly changes "spawn swims around" (spawn here may mean eggs/larvae, which swim), so use "telur/larva berenang di air".

monopterus-albus.name: Belut sawah
notes: Item 7: "lancefish" is left as English with no explanation; consider adding a local equivalent or a short gloss such as "ikan lancefish (sand lance)".
Item 11: "belut rawa" (for swamp eels) and "belut sawah" (for the same species elsewhere) are used inconsistently; pick one name.

myxocyprinus-asiaticus.name: Chinese Hi-Fin Banded Shark
notes: "Semua ikan yang diperdagangkan berasal dari budi daya dan merupakan hasil penangkaran" is redundant; budi daya and penangkaran say the same thing. Use one, e.g. "berasal dari hasil penangkaran/budi daya".
"mighty dorsal fin" became "sirip punggung besar", which loses the sense of a strong or imposing fin. Consider "sirip punggung yang megah/kokoh".
"semua ikan ini yang beredar di perdagangan" is awkward word order. Use "semua ikan jenis ini yang beredar di perdagangan" or similar.
"Chinese Whimple Carp" and "Batman-Loach" are left in English with no local name or explanation. Consider adding a note that this is a trade name, or italicise it.
"tahan menghadapi musim dingin" is clumsy. Use "tahan musim dingin" or "dapat bertahan di musim dingin di Eropa Tengah".

"Myxocyprinus" is the genus name, but the ID text does not give the full species name. This is fine if the source also omits it. Check that the genus is not mixed up with the common name "Chinese Whimple Carp".

oryzias-latipes.name: Medaka
notes: Item 8: "Sebagian besar tidak agresif terhadap Oryzias lain" is ambiguous. Say clearly whether it means the same species or other Oryzias species.
Item 11: "ikan gigi (toothcarp)" is not a common hobby term. Use "ikan gigi" with the Cyprinodontiformes context, or keep "toothcarp" alone.
Item 5: "Paling baik dipelihara di akuarium yang penuh tanaman air" is slightly stronger than "heavily planted". "Akuarium dengan banyak tanaman" would be more natural.

osphronemus-goramy.name: Gurami
notes: Item 1: 'Gurami, Osphronemus goramy' - 'giant gourami' translated as just 'Gurami'; use 'Gurami raksasa' or 'Gurame' to keep 'giant' (same in item 1 first sentence 'gurami berukuran besar').
Item 4: '72" x 24" x 24"' = 183 × 61 × 61 cm is correct, but 'Volume: ~681 liter' fine; no issue otherwise. Consider noting minimum tank depth/height explicitly.
Item 5: 'luar biasa jorok' is awkward/colloquial for 'exceptionally messy'; use 'sangat banyak menghasilkan kotoran'.
Item 5: 'Tanaman apung sebaiknya ada' is vague; the source says floating plants are preferable (as cover) - use 'Tanaman apung lebih disarankan'.
Item 8: 'ikan sapu-sapu (loricariid)' fine, but 'lele besar' for 'large catfish' acceptable; 'teman setangki' is non-standard, use 'ikan penghuni lain'.

Item 10: 'Pemijahan terjadi di sekitar sarang' fine, but 'burayak' for fry is OK; 'matang kelamin' acceptable. Item 10: 'Jantan membangun sarang ... (di alam termasuk rumput dan akar)' garbles 'including grasses and roots in nature'; use 'termasuk rumput dan akar di alam'.
Item 11: 'sangat membuat ikan stres' is awkward; use 'sangat membuat ikan stres' -> 'menyebabkan stres berat pada ikan'.

Item 11: 'Gurami sering dijual' - original says 'They' (O. goramy); also 'finnage' rendered as 'siripnya yang merah' loses 'red finnage' nuance slightly (fine). Item 11: 'dying' mistranslation check: 'varian yang diwarnai' correct but 'we strongly advise' became passive 'sangat disarankan' OK.

osteoglossum-bicirrhosum.name: Arwana Silver
notes: Item 8: "buah yang jatuh ke air" adds "ke air", which isn't in the source ("fallen nuts and fruits"). Use "buah dan biji-bijian yang berjatuhan".
Item 8: "kacang-kacangan" for "nuts" is slightly off for forest fruit; "biji-bijian" or "buah berkulit keras" fits better.
Item 10/2: "anakan" and "burayak" are mixed for fry/juveniles. Use "burayak" for fry and "anakan" for juveniles consistently.
Item 11: "sirip dubur" is correct but hobbyists more often write "sirip anal".

pangasianodon-hypophthalmus.name: Patin siam
notes: Item 10: "di peternakan ikan di Asia Timur dan Tenggara" adds "dan Tenggara", which the source ("Far Eastern fish farms") doesn't say. Use "Asia Timur", or a neutral "di Asia". Also prefer "tambak/kolam budidaya ikan" over "peternakan ikan".

Item 10: "akhir musim semi dan musim panas" is a literal rendering of the seasons. Indonesian readers may find it unnatural, since the Mekong's seasons are better described as the end of the dry season and the start of the rainy season. Consider a note or a neutral rewording.
Item 11: "sekitar satu meter" turns "a few feet" into one figure. "Beberapa kaki" is roughly 0.9–1.5 m, so "sekitar 1 meter atau lebih" is safer.

paracheirodon-axelrodi.name: Cardinal Tetra
notes: Item 9: EN says '20 gallons (about 75 litres)'. ID gives 'sekitar 75 liter'. This is acceptable, but the 54 L figure in item 8 conflicts with 75 L. That conflict is in the source, so ignore it.

Item 5: 'Since overfishing this quick-replenishing species would be nearly impossible' became 'hampir mustahil ditangkap berlebihan'. This is fine. However, 'anak Sungai Amazon' for 'Rio Negro tributary of the Amazon' is ambiguous. Reword it as 'Rio Negro, anak sungai Amazon'.
Item 20: EN says 'transfer them to the spawning tank in the evening'. ID says 'pada sore atau malam hari', which adds 'sore'. Use 'pada malam hari'.

Item 21: EN says 'They spawn in the evening'. ID says 'pada sore atau malam hari', which adds 'sore'. Use 'pada malam hari'. Also, 'paling banter bisa dibilang menantang' is awkward for 'challenging at best'. Use 'paling tidak menantang' or 'cukup sulit'.
Item 3: 'garis merahnya' is OK. 'tidak secerah aslinya' adds 'aslinya'. EN says 'isn't as vibrant', so leave it as 'kurang cerah'. Also, 'a hook protruding' in item 19 is fine.
Item 3: 'The red band extends the entire length of the body' and 'while in the neon tetra it runs only from mid-body to tail' are correct. No change needed.
Item 22: 'Hypessobrycon simulans' and 'P. inessi' keep source typos. Latin names must stay as they are, so no change.
Item 6: 'Pada musim kemarau... Saat hujan musim penghujan' is awkward. Write 'Saat musim hujan mulai'. 'Hampir sebagai ikan semusim (annual)' is acceptable.
Item 22: 'garis kromatofor ... yang meluas ke arah punggung' is acceptable. 'incertae sedis' is fine.
Item 17: Item 17's 'Lele kecil, terutama Corydoras' is fine. In item 16, 'tidak predator' is non-standard. Use 'bukan pemangsa'. 'lele callichthyid' is fine.

paracheirodon-innesi.name: Neon tetra
notes: #3 "warnanya tegas" for "robustly colored" is slightly odd; "warnanya cerah/pekat" is more natural.
#3 "farm/budidaya ikan" is mixed; use just "peternakan/budidaya ikan".
#9 "kimia airnya stabil" is stiff; "parameter air stabil" is more natural.
#22 "cukup memengaruhi vitalitas genetik" for "somewhat affected" is fine, but "garis lateral" for "lateral stripe" is confusing next to "gurat sisi" (lateral line); use "garis samping/pita biru".

pelvicachromis-pulcher.name: Kribensis
notes: Item 8: "sangat agresif" for "very vigorous" shifts meaning; use "sangat aktif/lincah" (or "aktif dan agresif").
Item 8: "characin kecil (seperti tetra)" adds a gloss not in the source; remove it or just keep "characin kecil".
Item 7: "Mau menerima hampir semua jenis pakan" is stiff; use "Menerima hampir semua jenis pakan" or "Mau makan hampir semua jenis pakan".

pethia-conchonius.name: Rosy barb
notes: Item 2: temperature range converted to metric is fine, but 'Minimum tank size: 30 gallons (about 110 litres)' is converted correctly; however 'Adult size: 6 inches (15 cm)' is OK. No error there.
Item 7: '20-gallon' ≈ 76 L, so 'sekitar 75 liter' is OK, but the text is consistent only if 30 gallons = 110 L; fine.
Item 19: 'a 20- or 30-gallon aquarium' became 'sekitar 75 atau 110 liter'; fine. 'sexual maturity at approximately 6 cm (2.5 inches)' OK.

Item 15: 'angelfish' translated as 'manfish (angelfish)'; manfish is the Indonesian name for Pterophyllum, but 'ikan manfish' could be ambiguous. Minor: keep as is or write 'angelfish (manfish)'.
Item 15: 'knifefish, ropefish' and 'dither fish' left in English without Indonesian explanation; add a brief gloss (e.g. 'ikan pengalih/dither fish').

phenacogrammus-interruptus.name: Congo Tetra
notes: Item 17: "sirip yang lebih megah" and "sirip megah" for "elaborate fins" is slightly odd. Use "sirip yang lebih panjang dan rumit" or "sirip yang lebih indah".
Item 4: "Galur ini stabil secara turun-temurun" for "breed true" reads stiffly. Something like "sifat warnanya menurun dengan baik pada keturunannya" would be more natural.

phractocephalus-hemioliopterus.name: Red Tail Catfish
notes: "ikan lancefish": English name left untranslated; use "ikan sandeel/lancefish (Ammodytes)" with a short gloss, or a local equivalent.
"batu koral besar yang halus": "koral" suggests coral. Use "kerikil/kerakal besar yang halus" or "batu sungai besar yang halus".
